name: Europe Morning Race
description:
Fancy a quick morning 5 km race before work? Join us each Wednesday at 6.30 AM CET (5.30 AM UTC) with 13 laps of the May Field, 5.2 km.

Choose the right category according to your speed/pace:
A: 14.0 kph+ / pace 4:10/km or faster
B: 12.0-13.99 kph / pace: 5:00/km - 4:20/km
C: 10.0-11.99 kph / pace: 5:10/km - 6:00 / km
D: 8 - 9.99 kph / pace: 6:10/km or slower

name: WTRL Duathlon Opt2 RUN
description:
WTRL's Duathlon League offers a unique and thrilling racing experience by combining biking on Zwift with the choice of running on Zwift or outside in real life. This makes it accessible to everyone and the ultimate test of racing versatility!

The series takes place every Wednesday year-round, allowing you to compete solo or for your club (or both!), with results and monthly leagues organized by age group, gender, and Zwift Club.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
You'll need to complete both the CYCLING and RUNNING events of the same option and complete at least 100m in each to record a score.

NO TREADMILL?
No problem! You can complete the run outside of Zwift. 
- Link your WTRL profile (www.wtrl.racing/profile/) to your Strava profile (Strava is free). 
- Sign-up for the Run Option through the Companion Zpp (but do not 'join the running event in-game). 
- Start and record your run on Strava within 5 minutes of finishing the bike ride, and we’ll handle the rest (your run score is usually processed within an hour).

FORMAT:
- 35 minutes of CYCLING 
- 7 minute 'Transition'
- 20 minutes of RUNNING

For full details, scoring, and registration, visit www.WTRL.racing/duathlon.

#wtrl #duathlon

name: INC Relentless Intervals
description:
Suitable for A riders as a base session, or B & C riders wanting to push themselves.

Examples of the drills are – Z2 with 15sec Z5/6 bursts every 6minutes, alternating Z2/Z3 in various durations, Z2 - Z4 ramps of decreasing duration and many other sessions.

All sessions will be around 60-90mins and will include a warm up so just grab your bottles and head straight to the pen.

This is an Innovation Cycling Training Ride Event – all riders are welcome. These events are put together to push you further than before, if you are feeling fresh hop on the front, if you need rest surf the draft. This training ride is part of the INC RELENTLESS training rides that happen daily with each day focusing on a different area of improvement.

Tips: Use the draft to rest and ensure you do not lose the draft.

name: SZR Sunrise Ride
description:
Welcome to SZR Sunrise

This is a group ride with the focus on remaining together.
The average pace PRIOR to any race finish will be 2.2 wkg. Suitable for D riders looking to become C’s and above
Sprints and intervals will be added at the discretion of the leader.
We will at times ride above and below the advertised pace, please don’t feel the need to tell the leader they will be aware!

Please regroup quickly after sprints, intervals or hills and sit between the yellow and red beacons.
This is not a recovery ride, we work hard and work as a team.

eventSubgroups.name: Liv du Tour Your Way (E)
eventSubgroups.description:
This is a social ride welcoming all riders. Our mission is to push you further than before, build your endurance, and have fun. If you are feeling strong, push to the front and drag the group, if not, just sit in the peloton.

We have the “rubber-band” activated, which means that it’s a no drop ride - no matter what level you are, you will be able to keep up, and the group WILL STAY TOGETHER. Note: The overall speed may be lower than in other rides due to the banding effect.

So hop on that bike, grab those bottles, and let’s ride!

name: Rowe & King - Wednesday Wake-up
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

Rowe & King's Workout Wednesday is a moderate intensity workout to help build and maintain your aerobic engine. A session suitable for 12 months of the year.


WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Rowe / Rowe & King. Ex Pro Cyclist with experience racing over Europe and European Champion on the track as a Junior in 2005 is now a qualified coach of 11 years. Rowe & King founded in 2016 is a family business with coaches Luke Rowe - Team INEOS Racer, Dani Rowe (formally King) - Olympic Champion London 2016 and Courtney Rowe accompanying Matt along with a team of additional coaches. More info at www.roweandking.com

This is part of the Workout Wednesday live broadcast series with Matt Rowe on Zwift Community Live. 
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

HELPFUL HINT

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. 

For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: Zwift Women's Training Club Workout
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

name: Cryo-Gen Punch Bunch Challenge (C)
description:
The Punch Bunch is a social ride at C pace with a spicy twist.

We roll together at a steady C pace on a rotating route each week, keeping the group smooth and social throughout.

Along the way, we’ll hit the sprint banners full gas — then regroup and roll on together.

And to finish things off — a mini race to the line. Save something for the end! 🏁

This is perfect if you want:

• A social group ride with a competitive edge
• To test your sprint and punch along the way
• A fun, welcoming group that always regroups — right up until the final showdown!

D riders can sit steady and enjoy the ride, while stronger riders can light it up on the sprints and battle it out in the finale.

Fresh route every week. Simple, effective, and a lot of fun.

HEALTH: We would advise any rider who is attempting a Zwift ride for the first time to ensure that their health should always take precedence over completing any ride. If you feel unwell or unable to continue please STOP.

NOTE: Exercise contributes to 25% weight loss; Healthy Eating (Not Diet) contributes to the other 75%. Be fit and Healthy.

4STAR Individual Time Trial League

It’s you versus the clock! The 4STAR Individual Time Trial League is a weekly solo challenge where riders start at set intervals and battle to post their best time. Push yourself, measure your progress, and see where you rank among the Zwift community. One rider. One clock. One goal — go faster every week. 🚴‍♂️💨

name: Endure IQ Training Squad Session
description:
--------------------
SESSION FOCUS
--------------------
The aim of this session is to build muscular endurance and durability at threshold. By trageting LT2 we maximally recruit fast oxidative muscle fibers which becoming too glycolytic. The aim is to develop the durability to execute longer threshold workouts.
--------------------
PRE-RIDE:
--------------------
10-Minute Glute Activation (Pre-Ride)
1. Glute Bridge – 2 x 15
2. Fire Hydrants – 10–12 each side
3. Banded Lateral Walks – 10–12 steps each way
4. Single-Leg Deadlift – 8–10 each side
5. Standing Kickbacks – 10–12 each side
Optional Finish: Pogos and 3–5 explosive skips or hops.
----------
Warm up
----------
15min easy build
----------
Main set
----------
15x60sec L4 50-60rpm 60sec easy
----------
Easy to finish
----------

eventSubgroups.name: Endure IQ Training Squad Session (E)
eventSubgroups.description:
--------------------
SESSION FOCUS
--------------------
The focus of this session is to spend as much time as possible at and above ~90% of your VO2max. The priority is on maintaining high power/pace during the work intervals. These sessions are highly stressful but great for generating adaptations that will improve your oxygen-carrying capacity and therefore top-end aerobic capacity. For long-distance triathletes, these sessions can also serve as an effective precursor to longer interval sessions.
Key physiological adaptations we are hunting today:
- Increased maximal cardiac output to push more oxygenated blood each beat
- Greater mitochondrial density so every muscle fiber can process that oxygen
- Improved muscle oxygen extraction to keep power high deep into the set
--------------------
Warm Up
--------------------
15min warm up
--------------------
Main Set
--------------------
5x30sec at FTP +30sec easy high cadence

3min L5 2min easy

2min L5 1min easy

1min L5 40sec easy

40sec L5 30sec easy

2x30sec L5 20sec easy

****3min easy between sets****

Repeat 2-3x

https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00421-020-04463-w

Cool Down

name: PACK Run: Step by Step + After Party
description:
New to running, coming back after some time off, or simply want a nice warm up or cool down session? Join us as we spend 30 minutes moving the legs in this slow-paced, social event. The goal of the event is to encourage folks to move.

The leader will average 8kph (7:30min/km) // 5mph (12min/mile) for the duration and it is expected everyone will stay together. This is a timed event, so we encourage runners to go at their own pace if the average pace is too fast and/or use a run/walk strategy.

**Note: if you utilize a run/walk strategy, please start with the walking portion so that you are not overrunning the group on each interval.**

Put your black and orange tops and socks on and let's get moving!

description:

name: Flanders Endurance Series
description:
Flanders Endurance Series is focused on long distance rides/races.
The global distance of these fondo's will always be around 100km or 2.30h depending on the course of the day.
Use these type of rides to build up your foundation and/or stamina ...
Do you have to finish the ride ? No, that’s not necessary, only when you want to end up in the results you have to do the « whole » ride !
Is this a race ? There will be results displayed for those who like to race it, but you can also tackle it as a great build-me-up endurance training.
Late join is possible.

Heart rate monitors are necessary when you want to end up in the ZP results !

It’s also a great opportunity for you to earn those missing ROUTE badges

name: Zwift TT Club Racing - Double Espresso
description:
The Time Trial. Cycling’s true leveler - just you and your legs versus everyone else in the field.

name: Workout Wednesday Run
description:
Join the Zwift Runners for a group run workout that will be of benefit to all distance runners.

The speeds for each group are based on a threshold speed of A group 15 kph, B 13 kph, C 11 kph, D 9 kph. We will start the intervals at that speed but increase the speed of the intervals we get into the workout. We encourage runners to choose the group closest to the effort level you want to run at and to keep to the nominal speed for that group to maintain the group dynamic. However if these speeds are significantly too low or high for you then you can choose to run in the group that is closest and then adjust the target speed up to 10% up or down in the game or via the Companion app.

If you have any questions about this event or want to find out more about Zwift Running in general then please visit the Zwift Runners Facebook group or zwift.com/run #gozwiftrun #wow

name: Team Italy Workout Series by Manuel Ferrari
description:
Welcome to the Team Italy High-Intensity WORKOUT Series, written by Manuel Ferrari (Manuel Bike Experience) open to all riders with the aim of improving your FTP and preparing for the next races.

The appointment will be for every Tuesday and Thursday evening and is connected with the workouts that we offer every Wednesday evening during the Team Italy Up and Down Intervals event.

Have you always dreamed of completing a ride of over 100 km? Participating in both Team Italy Up and Down Intervals events and today's workout on consecutive days will improve your endurance and transform your ride of over 100 km into a fun ride.

Please add the [ITA] tag after your name,
Your kit will be automatically selected, and all riders will appear with the same kit.
All riders will unlock our exclusive in-game kit at the end of the workout.

How the ERG workout mode works:
The Zwifters line up in the starting area like a normal event and once it starts the workout mode begins. Each one will stay together with the group regardless of the power supplied, calculated on the basis of your FTP current.

We strongly recommend that you perform one of the FTP tests, if this is not correctly estimated it could make the workout too demanding for your current level of preparation, or ineffective. For more information about FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift
This is the Facebook group of Team Italy
https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftitaly

https://www.strava.com/clubs/zwift_italy
This is the Manuel Bike Experience Youtube channel where you can relive some Workout and other interesting related topics:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCvkG00ZD9Td2LXMKkeu1R3Q
Join us! Have fun! Ride On!

name: ZLDR One Step At A Time
description:
Join Zwift Long-Distance Runners (ZLDR) run club for a relaxed 7.5k run. Whether you want to use this time to walk just to get your blood flowing or push for a new personal best or anything in between, this is a great session to join! Even if you can’t join for the full 7.5k, come for whatever you have available. We are a flexible group of walkers/runners who want to help you get consistent and get results.

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your running dreams and help you develop your running skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners and walkers who want to help you set and achieve new goals!

For more ZLDR fun and support, join our groups on social media platforms:

name: Run 10K Every Day Powered By NoblePro
description:
Come and join the longest running daily led running event on Zwift. This was the event that kickstarted the NoblePro Running Club in support of a world record attempt at consecutive daily10k runs.
The event has a healthy group of leaders who are friendly and chatty and will help you achieve your goal, not matter your experience. Feel free to join in the chat and become addicted like we all are.

Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it's not a race.
If you don't want to run 10k then come along for as long as you wish, the support is always appreciated.
The event runs at the same time each day, each day of the week there is a different course.

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/

https://kinni.co/devices/ - To see if your treadmill is compatible to link to Zwift.

description:
Flamme Rouge Racing have partnered with GIANT cycling and The Warrior Games (TWG) to bring to you GIANT du Tour in celebration of the Le Tour Femmes

9 Stages in 9 days just like the Tour - To keep things simple these are Public races by PACE Group (A-D) with mass release and 4 time options each day.

GIANT du Tour is MEN only - Racing
LIV du Tour is WOMEN only - Racing
Ride du Tour is offered by Bikealicious each day - Banded Group rides 

REGISTER for inclusion in RACING results

Tours are tracking GC, Polka Dot (climbers) and Green Jersey (sprinters) - ALL segments are in play and ALL are FASTEST through segment - check the rules on how this will work and how we track GC - if you are new to racing it will be a great event to get you going!

For all details and RACING RULES visit our website (link below)
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD groups (links on website)

Discord - LIV-GIANT du Tour channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the event

FRR Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS
TWG Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/Eepzzf4xQP
FCC Invite link: https://discord.gg/PucjATepvy


Smart Trainers & HRM - for RACING
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Heart rate monitors are advised

Race Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt or you feel unwell please STOP there will be another day.

name: Crit Cade Steering Race
description:
Steering Required: This event is designed to maximize the fun of Zwift Steering! If you have a steering device, now's the time to master those apexes and gain an advantage. If you do not have a steering device, unfortunately you will not be able to join.

Get ready for an electrifying dash under the lights in the Crit Cade Steering Racing Experience! This isn't your average crit—it's 8 laps of pure, high-octane racing Downtown Dolphin circuit, but with a thrilling arcade twist!

Power Up Pandemonium: This race features Power Ups! Strategically deploy your Boost Power ups to cut through the field. Timing is everything! Each Boost power up will give you a 10kph speed increase for 2 seconds!

Speed Boosts Galore: Keep your eyes peeled for additional Speed Boosts scattered across the course to give you that extra injection of pace when you need it most. But watch out because these boosts can move around, so you’ll need to be on top of your steering game!

Steering Required: This event is designed to maximize the fun of Zwift Steering! If you have a steering device, it’s the time to master those apexes and gain an advantage.

These events are held within our Zwift Labs club. This feature is still in development and we'd love your feedback on your experience.

description:

name: Stage 5 - Tour Fever
description:
Set your alarms—it’s Tour Fever! Ride the Tour de France and Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift your way, with stages inspired by both races. Cruise it, spin it, or turn up the pace—just don’t miss a stage. 

Two iconic races. One global community. Let’s ride.

name: DIRT 505 Wednesday Endurance Ride
description:
Welcome to the DIRT 505 Wednesday Endurance Ride!

Please join us weekly on Wednesdays at a pace of 2.6-2.8w/kg for 90 minutes.

The 505 rides take place Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday for 90 minutes at the same time and same consistent pace. Saturday's we ride for 120 minutes.

We kick off our rides with a 5 minute pace at 2.2w/kg to get us warmed up and together as a team. The fence is used throughout the ride to keep everyone together. The fence will not kick you off the ride but we do encourage all our riders to stay together as close to the beacon as possible. Our rides offer a 30 minute late join option.
The ride leader will stay as close to ride pace as possible. We try to change up the routes each week and some of the routes may include some small to moderate climbs.

Our group exists to encourage and build up cyclists around the world, no matter your time zone, fitness level, pro or amateur. We exist to encourage and build up a team culture of unity in the cycling community.

STRAVA DIRT CLUB:

https://www.strava.com/clubs/zwiftdirt

FACEBOOK DIRT GROUP:

https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftdirt

name: Zwift TT Club Racing - Double Espresso
description:
The Time Trial. Cycling’s true leveler - just you and your legs versus everyone else in the field.

Come join Zwift TT Club on Zwift for more Time Trial event information! https://www.zwift.com/clubs/b3d1a903-df49-44eb-9c6f-4ba9f0622efe/home

Join us as we embark on a series of events - each week you will have multiple chances to set your best time on the same route!

Over the course of the series, we’ll be using routes in the region of 15-25km.

Check out Zwiftpower.com after your event to see how well you stack up against the competition!

Don’t forget to check you’re using the fastest bike frame and wheels available to you!

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? 
For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H 

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

name: Workout Wednesday Run
description:
Join the Zwift Runners for a group run workout that will be of benefit to all distance runners.

The speeds for each group are based on a threshold speed of A group 15 kph, B 13 kph, C 11 kph, D 9 kph. We will start the intervals at that speed but increase the speed of the intervals we get into the workout. We encourage runners to choose the group closest to the effort level you want to run at and to keep to the nominal speed for that group to maintain the group dynamic. However if these speeds are significantly too low or high for you then you can choose to run in the group that is closest and then adjust the target speed up to 10% up or down in the game or via the Companion app.

If you have any questions about this event or want to find out more about Zwift Running in general then please visit the Zwift Runners Facebook group or zwift.com/run #gozwiftrun #wow

description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

It’s high noon… and the real heroes are on their bikes.

Join the Bikealicious Highnoon-Heroes every Wednesday for one glorious hour of midday spin therapy.



This is a Banded Ride, which means:

name: Xert Surplus Seeker Ride
description:
This is a friendly group ride for users of Xert, want-to-be-users of Xert, or anyone from around the world who’d like to ride Wednesdays in a social, friendly setting. Difficulty is low as we will aim to ride together at a pace of 2.0-2.5 W/kg every week to build XSS (strain). The ride will be hosted by the team at Xert so while we’re primarily here to meet riders in the best way we know how - from the saddles of our bikes -  we’ll happily answer questions about the system (oxygen availability depending!). We will do our best to keep the group together so please keep your eyes open for a virtual tug on the jersey pocket (messages)..

Our Discord voice channel can be found @ https://discord.gg/Uqkd2Rx

name: KISS at Base Training Ride
description:
Join us to work on your endurance and power output at your aerobic threshold (AT) in Zone 2. The exercise will give you endurance and increased performance using fat as energy. A well-developed AT can give you better race performance increase the amount of time before your body uses glycogen stores.

Our Wednesday ride starts with a mass start. Pick the category you think you belong in and if you want to go harder or easier during the ride you can float between groups. All groups ride the same course and are visible.

We are now offering four separate paced rides to better accommodate various fitness levels.
The A cat is for riders with a Zone 2 above 3.80 w/kg.
The B cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 3.2 - 3.80 w/kg.
The C cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 2.5 - 3.19 w/kg.
The D cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 2.2 - 2.49 w/kg.
Remember this when you approach hills and inclines along the way. Stick together to enjoy the draft and companionship. The ride leader will not exceed the advertised pace at any time - even on hills. Please keep an eye on the leader beacon (yellow) and the sweeper beacon (red) to stay in the blob.

So turn on your graph (press G on computer keyboard or select it from on-screen menu in iOS and Android) and paint it blue. Give the body a good foundation for Zwift racing. Discord server Link: https://discord.gg/kBmXhY2

Wednesday's feature a bit of climbing to spice up your base training, I am sure you will enjoy it.

name: RO4H Wednesday Spin
description:
The RO4H Wednesday Spin is the midweek social group ride where our friendly, casual, supportive, and respectful RO4H atmosphere welcomes everyone, from the most seasoned Zwifter to the first-time group ride participant. We strive to harness the power of the group draft, encourage comradery, and embrace the RO4H motto that we are better together.

The yellow peloton's pace varies depending on the terrain, but the ride will have an overall average pace of around 19 MPH (30 KPH). The peloton's pace on the flat sections will be slightly faster due to the strong draft effect of the peloton. We strive to remain under 2 W/KG on climbs. Routes are typically flat with short hills; most Zwift routes have some rolling terrain. Sometimes, we take slightly hillier routes to earn different route badges, but most rides will be gently rolling, flatter terrain. Speedsters do have a chance to stretch their legs during the optional "Speed Deacon Sprint" featured on the final lap.

We encourage riders to stick with the yellow peloton led by the ride leader in order to promote the social aspect of the ride and benefit from the large group draft effect. This is unquestionably not a race, despite the belief held by some that every Zwift ride is. We do not pursue flyers, but they are free to fly*.

While our goal is to be a no-drop ride, any pace ultimately represents a great effort for some and a recovery pace for others. Therefore, sweepers are available to assist riders. We do not want anyone to ride alone unless they choose to. The sweeper team will help riders bridge to the leader's peloton or form variable-pace gruppettos. I hear that all the "cool kids" hang out in the sweeper bus anyway.
So join the RO4H Wednesday Spin, where friends are plentiful and we are better together.

*If you are a flyer, please do not organize your flyers using the group in-game chat. This confuses other riders trying to find the main yellow peloton and disrupts the social aspect of the ride. Please use private messages to communicate within your flyer group. We do not use the active fence but will if flyers disrupt the social aspect of this ride.

Angela Naeth is a professional triathlete, coach, and founder of IRACELIKEAGIRL - a community of girls/women who provide opportunities for females of all ages and abilities to support, encourage and inspire one another in the sport of triathlon, cycling, running and swimming. name: Veselka Ride for Ukraine
description:
Join the Veselka Cycling team on a solidarity ride to support Ukraine.
There may not be much we can do but we must try to do what we can.
Veselka Restaurant has been serving up traditional Ukrainian food in the heart of NYC’s East Village since 1954
The neighborhood is home to one the largest Ukrainian communities outside of Europe and is now on the receiving end of an outpouring of love and support. We are working closely with “Razom for Ukraine”, a non-profit organization assisting the people of that country in their continued quest for democracy and progress. We have also partnered with Ostroy, a NYC cycling label founded in the East Village, to create a limited edition blue and yellow Ukraine jersey based on our team’s traditional design.
All participants in the Solidarity Ride will line up at the start, wearing our Veselka team kit during the event.
We hope this ride will “travel” into different corners of the world - via social media or as a series of like minded rides - all to express peaceful solidarity in support of Ukraine. This will be an on-going weekly ride to continue our efforts to support Ukraine.

Veselka Restaurant and Veselka Cycling Team
*Veselka.com
*RazomforUkraine.org
*Ostroy.com

name: Stage 5 - Tour Fever
description:
Set your alarms—it’s Tour Fever! Ride the Tour de France and Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift your way, with stages inspired by both races. Cruise it, spin it, or turn up the pace—just don’t miss a stage. 

Two iconic races. One global community. Let’s ride.

name: DIRT Mid-Week Frat Party
description:
Welcome to the Wednesday DIRT Mid-Week Ride, also known as the Frat Party your legs actually enjoy. This is DIRT’s midweek mixer, part social ride, part casual workout, and part slightly sweaty fashion show.

We keep the pace friendly, the banter flowing, and the vibe high. Expect steady efforts, good company, and plenty of chances to reconnect, recover, and ride with your fellow DIRTy friends.

Bring your wildest virtual kit and your most mismatched socks. There are no dress codes here. Just good company, good legs, and questionable fashion choices.

Just a midweek ride with your crew. Come for the party, stay for the good vibes.

Team DIRT stands for Dads Inside Riding Trainers. We are a brotherhood and sisterhood of like minded riders who care deeply about our families and have a deep love for cycling too.

eventSubgroups.name: DIRT Mid-Week Frat Party (C)
eventSubgroups.description:
Welcome to the Wednesday DIRT Base Training Social Ride Ride of Team DIRT

Please join us weekly on Wednesday morning for a C level ride.

Team DIRT is an acronym for Dads Inside Riding Trainers. This group has grown and brought like minded moms and dads together who love to make time for Zwift around work and family.

Please join us on discord: https://discord.gg/sUnwqPZ

And Facebook at: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ZWIFTDIRT

name: ODivaZ 2.3 Ride
description:
All riders are welcome to join the ODivaZ 2.3 Ride, led by the Women of TeamODZ, where we take pride in keeping the pace at the advertised average of 2.3 watts/kilogram.  The ride is approximately 1 hour on a flat or semi-flat course (actual time/distance depends on the Zwift course of the day). Contingent on the course, there will be optional sprints and/or short "spicy segment(s)" (2.7-3.0 w/kg). The leader announces any pace changes and will slow to re-group after each sprint or spicy segment. 

This is NOT A RACE!  We invite all riders to stay with the leader (yellow beacon) and enjoy friendly Zwift messaging and the community feel of this ride.  Although we don’t use Double Draft, the regular draft allows the large group around the beacon to move at a fast pace. 

ODZ members vocally chat on an app called Discord. Discord is not required, but the ride experience is enhanced by using it. Click on this link for more information about Discord and related setup: Discord.teamodz.com

For more specifics about this ride and the various Zwift courses, go to: http://www.TeamODZ.com/ODivaZ/

#odz

name: CAT & MOUSE KZR CHASE RACE
description:
CAT & MOUSE KZR CHASE RACE는 다양한 레벨의 라이더들을 위한 추격 레이스 입니다. 각 그룹은 약 2~4분의 간격으로 출발합니다.(코스에 따라 변동가능) 가장 낮은 레벨의 C 그룹이 먼저 출발합니다. 이 레이스의 목표는 다른 그룹에게 잡히기 전에 레이스를 완료하는 것입니다. 우승 그룹을 결정하는 방법은 LEADER가 속한 팩이 골라인을 통과할때 그 그룹의 수가 가장 많은 그룹이 우승하게 됩니다. 코스는 매주 변경되며 코스 길이는 대략 40KM이며 60 분 이내에 종료됩니다. TTT (팀 타임 트라이얼) 라이딩 스타일과 과도한 B.A는 금지되어 있으며, 승리를 위해 리더 또는 스위퍼그룹과 함께하시기 바랍니다.
-
CAT & MOUSE KZR CHASE RACE is a chasing race for different levels of riders. Each group starts with 2~4mins time difference. The lowest level group will start first accordingly.The goal is to finish the route before other group catches . The winning group will be chosen based on the number of people who finished the goal line with a group LEADER. The course changes every week and the route is roughly 40KM long and aims to be finished within 60 mins. TTT(Team Time Trial) riding style and excessive B.A is prohibited and please pace yourself with a group Leader and Sweeper. Starting Time(KST): (C) 20:30, (B) 20:34, (A) 20:36 
-
* 결과와 소식은 즈위프트한국유저그룹에서 확인하세요. https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftkorea/
* 순위 측정과 완주여부를 확인하기 위해 https://zwiftpower.com/에 들어가 가입하고, www.zwift.com에 로그인 ‘My Profile’로 들어가 ‘Connetions’ 메뉴에서 ' Opt-in' 옵션에 동의 하시기 바랍니다. 
-
* The official record will be announced to https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftkorea/ 
* To check your ranking and completion, sign up at https://zwiftpower.com/, sign in at www.zwift.com and agree to the 'Opt-in' option.

name: Workout Wednesday Run
description:
Join the Zwift Runners for a group run workout that will be of benefit to all distance runners.

The speeds for each group are based on a threshold speed of A group 15 kph, B 13 kph, C 11 kph, D 9 kph. We will start the intervals at that speed but increase the speed of the intervals we get into the workout. We encourage runners to choose the group closest to the effort level you want to run at and to keep to the nominal speed for that group to maintain the group dynamic. However if these speeds are significantly too low or high for you then you can choose to run in the group that is closest and then adjust the target speed up to 10% up or down in the game or via the Companion app.

If you have any questions about this event or want to find out more about Zwift Running in general then please visit the Zwift Runners Facebook group or zwift.com/run #gozwiftrun #wow

description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

description: WTRL's Duathlon League offers a unique and thrilling racing experience by combining biking on Zwift with the choice of running on Zwift or outside in real life. This makes it accessible to everyone and the ultimate test of racing versatility!

name: BMTR Short Adventure
description:
The BMTR Short Adventure focuses on enjoying a fun group experience while participating in endurance-paced cycling.

Our ride leaders are experienced, friendly, and ready to make sure you have a great experience. They'll help keep the ride fun and within the right pace for your group!

This event is mainly about "Zone 2 Endurance" riding, which means we’ll be cycling at a comfortable pace. Each category has an average watts per kilogram (w/kg) range designed to keep most riders in their "Zone 2 Endurance" or low "Zone 3 Tempo" zones. Just choose the category that fits your Functional Threshold Power (FTP) or the one that Zwift assigns to you, and you’ll be all set for an enjoyable ride!

- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/bmtrzwiftclub

name: PAOLO BARBERA & SCANNELLATORI SERIALI WORKOUT
description:
"Scannellatori Seriali" is a large community of cyclists, triathletes, and runners. We invite you to join our community by following our Instagram page at https://www.instagram.com/scannellatori_seriali/ or contacting us on Facebook.
 
Coach Paolo Barbera (Please visit www.heycoach.it )   is a Certified Triathlon and Ironman Coach and the founder of Active Kids, a sporting clinic to help children and adults in the prevention and treatment of obesity through healty nutrition and tailored training programs

Paolo is an experienced thriathlete and cyclist, in 2017 opened an endurance training center in milan, Tri60, specilized in indoor training.

In the last ten years Paolo has developed training programs for triathletes, runners and cyclists. Indoor training plays a key role to control pace, cadence and mental strenght.

Paolo’s workouts are designed to mix different training zones aiming to maximize results in a very short time. Paolo’s coachees by following his workouts, at the right intensity, have achieved challenging results.

description:
Join us for a fun weekly ride led by Specialized Team and ambassadors. Each week you will have the opportunity to ride different bikes depending on the route. Some days we will do tempo flat efforts on our road bikes and some days we will take you on the road less travelled!

So lets put on your cycling kit, turn up your fan and ride with us. Do tag us on IG and use #nevernotriding hashtag!

37 – 40kmph

name: CHINA ZCRC Group Training Ride
description:
欢迎参加CHINA ZCRC Group Training Ride，这场周三夜晚的线上团练由ZCRC和G7 Cycling Club联合举办。
 
在团练期间，我们的领队会实时发布本次团练课程的指令，训练的目的可能会涉及到短时间歇、阈值训练等，通过这些训练来提升你的FTP、FRC和最大功率能力。
 
同时，你将会在这一次的团练中认识许多不同的新朋友，我们非常欢迎来自全世界各地的骑行爱好者加入我们的团练，如果你感觉精力充沛，可以完全按照领队的指示在集团前方进行课程训练，如果你感觉余力不足，尝试在集团中降低功率以享受充足的跟风效果，我们由衷地希望所有的伙伴都能拥有一次完美的团练体验！
 
每场团练的最后，我们通常会进行一场不计排名的小比赛，为了小比赛的公平性，请确保你始终保持在领队身后直至比赛开始，然后在最后的小比赛尝试榨干你的全部体能。
 
* B组一般会进行适合3.0-4.0w/kg水平车手的团练课程
 
* E组通常是自由强度的骑行
 
欢迎关注我们ZCRC的其他公开活动并且参与其中：

CHINA ZCRC Winter Challenge Series

*微信群: hzw-hzw-hzw
*新浪微博: ZWIFT_CHINA
*Instagram: ZWIFT_CHINA
 
This group-training ride is brought to you by ZCRC and G7 Cycling Club from China.
 
During the ride, we will cover a broad range of exercises and focus on using short time intervals to improve your FTP, PMAX Power and FRC Capacity etc.
 
In the meantime, you will definitely meet new friends by riding with us. We warmly welcome all riders from all over the world! If you are feeling fresh, hop on to the front with the leader. If you are tired, then rest with the group by surfing the draft. We hope everyone will have a great workout session!
 
Group Training Rule: All riders should behind and group with the beacon (leader or sweeper), follow the session pace which leader say. No surge, no attack until final mini race. Let's respect leader and group.
 
*There will be a mini race at the end of the ride. In order to be included in the final results, make sure you ride behind the group leader before the mini race starts. Let’s all keep the mini race fair and square.
 
*Group B will have workout session for 3.0-4.0w/kg riders.
 
*Group E will have free ride and pace for all category riders.

name: Stage 5 - Tour Fever
description:
Set your alarms—it’s Tour Fever! Ride the Tour de France and Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift your way, with stages inspired by both races. Cruise it, spin it, or turn up the pace—just don’t miss a stage. 

Two iconic races. One global community. Let’s ride.

name: Stage 5 - Race - Tour Fever
description:
The race is on. Tour Fever brings the Tour de France and Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift together—now it’s your turn to race them. Full gas from the start, hold the wheel, and bring it to the line. Every stage counts.

TOUR FEVER STAGE REWARDS
1 Stage: Tour Fever Gloves + Socks
2 Stages: 500 XP
3 Stages: Tour Fever Helmet
4 Stages: 500 XP
5 Stages: Tour Fever Kit + Watch the Femmes Kit
ROUTE PROGRESSION REWARDS
7 Routes: 500 XP
10 Routes: Tour Fever Bucket Hat

120 m / 394 ft
PowerUp: Feather + Aero

—------------------

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

Looking for extra motivation? The GC (General Classification) Competition lets you track your progress across all stages. Each race counts—your times add up throughout the series, shaping the overall standings. At the end of the series, the fastest total time takes the win!

VIEW RESULTS: http://zwift.com/racing/leagues/tourfever2026
—------------------

YOUR RACING PROFILE
Every race tells a story. Head to your Racing Profile on Zwift.com to track your performance, follow your progress, and see how your racing evolves over time. Review your results, compare key efforts, and build a deeper picture of your racing, race by race.
VIEW YOUR PROFILE: http://zwift.com/athlete/me
—------------------

Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh


ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter


Hourly Racing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

description:
A very warm welcome to our ZZRC Group Workout. 

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

The power targets are based on your individual FTP so come join us as we encourage each other to elevate our fitness to new heights on Zwift. 

Whilst we enjoy having a yellow beacon on our workouts to give support  , occasionally it’s not always possible. The workout will continue as normal and will give you the instructions required throughout despite no beacon . So please enjoy the challenge . 

Join the ZZRC Club on the Companion App, follow us on Facebook, but, most of all, enjoy the ride.

name: USMeS - Boot Camp🥾 [C] 2.2 - 2.8w/kg
description:
Boot Camp 2.2-2.8
Discipline. Effort. Results.

Welcome to Bootcamp, your weekly C-paced ride where discipline meets intensity. This isn’t just another group ride—this is where you put in the work.

Pace: 2.2–2.8 w/kg 
Average: ~2.5 w/kg overall
Fence: In use—and it has no mercy. Stay behind the beacon or risk being zapped.

Ride Format:
    • Steady endurance pacing throughout
    • Segment efforts are highly encouraged—bring your best watts
    • Sprints and climbs will test your focus
    • Regroup quickly behind the beacon after each effort

Expectations:
Respect the fence—it’s there to keep everyone disciplined
Use segments to push hard, then fall back in formation
Ride smart, ride steady, and support each other

This is the ride where you earn your progress. Bootcamp is all about consistency, commitment, and a little bit of grit.

Fall in, work hard, and finish strong.

Please join our Discord https://discord.gg/uyE2eUh4yE  and join our Zwift Club and FB by searching “US Military eSports”

name: THE SYN 100
description:
Join us for "The SYN 100" group ride on TT bikes! 

This ride is all about teamwork, smooth rotations, and catching up with our community. 
Whether you’re joining to set the pace or sit in and enjoy the draft, what matters most is that you have fun!

We will be taking on 100 km at an average pace of 2.5-3w/kg, ETA +- 2.5 hours. 
Everyone will be on the Canyon Speedmax TT bike — so we’ll be rolling in full style and speed. Double draft is on! 

Perfect for boosting your stamina and endurance, this ride challenges you to hold a steady power output for a sustained duration.

Late join is active for the first 30 minutes of this ride.


3 SPRINTS WITH LEAD-OUT
Tempus Fugit is perfect for time trial efforts, group pacing, and steady endurance work. 
It features the Fuego Flats Sprint — 500 meters of all-out power!
We are riding 5 laps on Tempus Fugit. The first 3 laps we will be organising a sprint with lead-out! 


FINISHING WITH A CHASE
At the end of this ride we have "The spicy 5 ". We’ll lift the pace near the end with 5km to go and go for a fast finish for those who still have energy left. 
Others can just choose to easy spin at a nice pace to the finish line.


UNLOCK THE SYNDICATE CLUB KIT
Completing the full 100km ride today will result in unlocking the inverted SYN Kit that you will be wearing on this ride!
SYN Cycling Club also has other rides that unlock this kit, make sure to check them out!


DISCOVER MORE IN THE SYN ZWIFT CLUB
Enjoyed this ride? Feel free to join our Zwift Club (SYN Cycling Club), and discover all our events:
https://bit.ly/SYNZwiftClub

name: GIANT du Tour - Hilly - Race
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing have partnered with GIANT cycling and The Warrior Games (TWG) to bring to you GIANT du Tour in celebration of the Le Tour Femmes

9 Stages in 9 days just like the Tour - To keep things simple these are Public races by PACE Group (A-D) with mass release and 4 time options each day.

GIANT du Tour is MEN only - Racing
LIV du Tour is WOMEN only - Racing
Ride du Tour is offered by Bikealicious each day - Banded Group rides 

REGISTER for inclusion in RACING results

Tours are tracking GC, Polka Dot (climbers) and Green Jersey (sprinters) - ALL segments are in play and ALL are FASTEST through segment - check the rules on how this will work and how we track GC - if you are new to racing it will be a great event to get you going!

For all details and RACING RULES visit our website (link below)
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD groups (links on website)

Discord - LIV-GIANT du Tour channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the event

FRR Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS
TWG Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/Eepzzf4xQP
FCC Invite link: https://discord.gg/PucjATepvy


Smart Trainers & HRM - for RACING
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Heart rate monitors are advised

Race Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt or you feel unwell please STOP there will be another day.

description:
Set your alarms—it’s Tour Fever! Ride the Tour de France and Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift your way, with stages inspired by both races. Cruise it, spin it, or turn up the pace—just don’t miss a stage. 

Two iconic races. One global community. Let’s ride.

description:

YOUR RACING PROFILE

VIEW YOUR PROFILE: http://zwift.com/athlete/me

Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh


ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter


Hourly Racing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: Phoenix Rising Midweek Meander
description:
It's time for Phoenix Rising's Midweek Meander! This is a D paced ride designed to allow a wide range of riders to join in the fun and get what they need, whether it's a workout, warm up/down or recovery. Join us for this chatty, social ride, where riders of all levels can experience a sense of community with others from all over the world. The pace will be in the range of 1.4 - 1.7 w/kg but may go slightly higher on any climbs and lower on descents depending on the ride leader's weight. Sticking with the yellow beacon rather than flying ahead is appreciated. The fence will be activated as a guide and sweeps will be on hand to assist those who lose the draft. We want everyone to feel supported and part of the group. Our routes change weekly, promising fresh challenges and new horizons on routes that are always somewhat flat-ish. Let's soar together as we chase away those midweek blahs!

For more information on all our weekly events, join our club Phoenix Rising on Zwift Companion.

Join us on Discord during the ride: https://discord.gg/mNMva8ekJR
Check us out on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/groups/615972979730125/

name: Workout Wednesday Run
description:
Join the Zwift Runners for a group run workout that will be of benefit to all distance runners.

The speeds for each group are based on a threshold speed of A group 15 kph, B 13 kph, C 11 kph, D 9 kph. We will start the intervals at that speed but increase the speed of the intervals we get into the workout. We encourage runners to choose the group closest to the effort level you want to run at and to keep to the nominal speed for that group to maintain the group dynamic. However if these speeds are significantly too low or high for you then you can choose to run in the group that is closest and then adjust the target speed up to 10% up or down in the game or via the Companion app.

If you have any questions about this event or want to find out more about Zwift Running in general then please visit the Zwift Runners Facebook group or zwift.com/run #gozwiftrun #wow

name: EVO CC Sprint Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

name: Team Italy Workout Series by Manuel Ferrari
description:
Welcome to the Team Italy High-Intensity WORKOUT Series, written by Manuel Ferrari (Manuel Bike Experience) open to all riders with the aim of improving your FTP and preparing for the next races.

The appointment will be for every Tuesday and Thursday evening and is connected with the workouts that we offer every Wednesday evening during the Team Italy Up and Down Intervals event.

Have you always dreamed of completing a ride of over 100 km? Participating in both Team Italy Up and Down Intervals events and today's workout on consecutive days will improve your endurance and transform your ride of over 100 km into a fun ride.

Please add the [ITA] tag after your name,
Your kit will be automatically selected, and all riders will appear with the same kit.
All riders will unlock our exclusive in-game kit at the end of the workout.

How the ERG workout mode works:
The Zwifters line up in the starting area like a normal event and once it starts the workout mode begins. Each one will stay together with the group regardless of the power supplied, calculated on the basis of your FTP current.

We strongly recommend that you perform one of the FTP tests, if this is not correctly estimated it could make the workout too demanding for your current level of preparation, or ineffective. For more information about FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: DBR Midweek Social Ride
description:
Join Danish Bike Riders on our weekly Social Ride. We will be riding at an average pace of 30-35km for 60min, mostly flat routes, but some routes are faster than others. We ride without the Fence, and perhaps also a bit different from many other Social Rides. RideLeader will keep a steady pace, but its ok to ride ahead and join other riders in front - Just remember to be Social. If you find yourself at the back, please call for a wheel, and we will try to get you back to the RideLeaders group. Stronger riders are as always welcome to help at the back. We look forward to ride with you.

Info on events and the [DBR] team can be found on “Danish Bike Riders” on FaceBook (English) https://www.facebook.com/DanishBikeRiders and in our group “Danish Bike Riders” https://www.facebook.com/groups/1160541327367604/ 

Ride On

#dbr

name: Team DRAFT Wednesday Race
description:
WHAT IS CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT?

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for. Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You can not race in the D category.

Welcome to the Wednesday Race brought to you by Team DRAFT!

We encourage all participants to head over to zwiftpower.com and register. Riders who have not completed the Zwiftpower registration and agreed to the sharing conditions will not be included in the official results.

To make this race as fair as possible, we require that all riders wear a heart rate monitor, use a power meter and/or smart trainer, and choose the appropriate race category for your ability. Riding in an inappropriate category will lead to your disqualification.

RULES:
- No zPower riders.
- Heart rate monitors mandatory for all categories
- 5min and 20min CEVAZ limits apply. Riding in the wrong category will lead to disqualification.

RACE CATEGORIES:
A: 4.0 W/kg to 5.0 W/kg
B: 3.2 W/kg to 3.99 W/kg
C: 2.5 W/kg to 3.19 W/kg
D: Under 2.49 W/kg

description:
Join our mid-week social ride led by members of the Invictus Games Foundation’s international community of serving military personnel and veterans who use cycling to recover from wounds, injury or sickness (WIS).

This is a 1-2 w/kg weekly group ride, with the goal of keeping the group together. This event is open to riders of any ability, including those who ride upright bikes, and we especially welcome those who use handcycles, recumbent trikes, trikes, or tandems in real life.

Follow the ride leader's instructions and stay as close to the beacon as possible. If you're feeling strong, please use your abilities to help pull fellow riders back to the pack. If you are feeling weak, join the lantern rouge at the back for a more leisurely ride

This is a social ride, not a race. Use the draft, take a coffee break.

Late joiners allowed.

If you are a member of the WIS community and happy to let the group know, please write [IGF] after your name on your profile.
For more information about the Invictus Games Foundation please go to https://invictusgamesfoundation.org/

name: Ride Club Finland: DNF Elite
description:
DNF Elite is a scratch race for riders who know that FTP doesn’t define glory - attitude does. Whether you spin like a sleepy hamster or grind like a coffee machine, this is your stage. 
 
Here, “DNF” stands for “Do Not Fret” - because finishing is optional, but fun is mandatory. Every effort counts, even the ones that end in the pain cave or the pizza queue.
 
A - Almost Elite: top tier of the not-so-top, pain faces guaranteed, results optional.
B - Bonk Buddies: we start strong, fade fast, and always blame the trainer.
C - Chain-drop Champions: still figuring out which gear to use - and proud of it!
 
Rules & Spirit 
- Category: choose the one that matches your ZRS - or your sense of humor.
- Excuses: unlimited.Sandbagging: only if it’s a yoga move. 
- Occasional “why did I sign up for this again?” moments. 
- Everyone’s a winner, some just cross the line a bit later.
 
Join the Ride Club Finland: DNF Elite peloton and celebrate the fine art of trying just hard enough. See you at the start pens — bring watts, wit, and your finest self-deprecating spirit.

description:
Vitality, in partnership with UNICEF, is teaming up with Zwift for a series of great social rides for a fantastic cause. Don’t miss out. Join our social rides of 45 minutes to one hour and do your part to give kids a head start. Keeping you active and helping Vitality and UNICEF vaccinate millions of children worldwide.

We encourage everyone to stay together for this social ride. Every ride completion will help UNICEF vaccinate a child against polio.

About Vitality:
 
Guided by a core purpose of making people healthier, Vitality is the leader in shared-value by creating healthy behavior changes in insurance. By blending technology, data, incentives, and behavioural science, Vitality inspires healthy changes in individuals and organizations. 

In partnership with UNICEF, Vitality aims to vaccinate millions of children against polio by donating vaccines on behalf of participants who complete the Vitality for UNICEF Ride series events.

Furthermore, the partnership with Zwift has been established as part of Vitality’s global pledge to get 100 million people 20% more active by 2025 through incentives to live healthier, more active lifestyles.

name: Vikings Valhalla Recovery Ride
description:
Welcome to the midweek Recovery Ride hosted by the mighty teams Vikings and Valhalla on Zwift! Join us as we embark on a journey through the virtual landscapes of Zwift, where camaraderie meets relaxation in a friendly and social atmosphere.
As the sun sets on Wednesday evening in Europe, saddle up and pedal alongside fellow riders who share a passion for both fitness and fun. This isn't your typical high-intensity workout—instead, it's a chance to unwind, recover, and rejuvenate those tired legs from previous rides or races.
Our pace is relaxed, our spirits high, and our chat is always filled with laughter and camaraderie. Whether you're a seasoned cyclist or just starting out, everyone is welcome to join in the fun. Share your favorite ride stories, exchange training tips, or simply enjoy the company as we pedal through the virtual roads of Zwift.
So grab your bike, hop on Zwift, and join us for an evening of leisurely pedaling, good vibes, and plenty of laughs. Let's roll together towards recovery, one pedal stroke at a time!
To find out more about our rides, please visit our Valhalla Ride and Race Facebook group https://www.facebook.com/groups/503388660165279/ or our website https://www.skaal.cc

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO CC Race series.Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, C &D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

Please check out Facebook page evolution cycling for result and more information.

name: Endurance Beat Pro
description:
Description:
This workout is designed to build your aerobic endurance while maintaining a steady and manageable effort. It consists of a long warm-up, steady state intervals at endurance pace, and a cool-down. Ideal for riders aiming to improve their long-distance capabilities without overreaching.

Structure:
• Warm-Up:
• 10 minutes starting easy and gradually increasing to 55% of FTP.
• Main Set:
• 40 minutes at 70–80% of FTP (Endurance Zone),
• 2:30/3:00 minutes of easy pedaling (55% FTP) between each 40-minute block.
• Cool-Down:
• 10 minutes gradually decreasing effort to % of FTP.

Key Points:
• Focus on maintaining a smooth, efficient pedal stroke.
• Keep your cadence steady between 85–95 rpm.
• Breathing should be controlled; you should be able to hold a conversation during the main intervals.
• Nutrition and hydration are important for sessions lasting over an hour.
Key Elements
Ideal for building aerobic endurance
Keeps attention high thanks to gentle variations
Great for indoor sessions focused on continuous worklink

Baltic Charge Racing League – Your Path to Peak Performance!

The league will consist of 12 stages, with only the best 8 results out of 12 counting towards the overall standings – so consistency, smart race choices, and tactical planning will be key to success!

Step up to the challenge in the Baltic Charge Racing League, where speed, endurance, and strategy come together in a thrilling test of skill.

Inspired by the rich cycling culture of the Baltic States, this series is designed to push riders to new heights with dynamic, fast-paced racing on Zwift’s most iconic routes. More than just a competition, these races are the perfect way to fine-tune your form, sharpen your tactics, and build race-ready fitness ahead of the classical cycling season outdoors.

Expect strategic breakaways, decisive sprints, and non-stop action as riders from around the world push each other to be better with every pedal stroke. No matter how little you’ve run, no matter how “slow” you think you are, no matter what your circumstance. We would like to help you realize your dream of getting to that distant finish line.

ZLDR is a group of diverse runners, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your running dreams and help you develop your running skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners who will make sure that you are never left behind.

name: Vision Valkyrie - Recovery Ride
description:
Spin it up! 🥏🌀
This workout helps you improve agility for sprinting. The spinups in high cadence intervals will teach you how to quickly turn your legs, produce power, while keeping the upper body still as a statue and really work on that form. The rotation per minute of your legs (cadence) number will be guided throughout the workout. In between those sets there will be a contrast, low cadence for a couple minutes. 
ERG mode is recommended so you can totally focus on the cadence. 
This workout is found in the recovery folder and is indeed a recovery day workout; from the Jumbo Visma women's team. But! Your heart rate will certainly go up a lot when we are on the high cadence intervals and that is totally normal. Those fast movements to produce high cadence will need some extra heart pumps and get that blood moving.

name: Dragons RT Raceday
description:
Welcome to the weekly Dragons RT Raceday, the midweek race designed for riders who want more than just another group ride.

Every Wednesday, we race a new route in a full-gas scratch race with all categories visible and a single start.

This event is the ideal transfer race between ZRL on Tuesday and TTT on Thursday, and a perfect opportunity for riders who missed ZRL or are not racing TTT but still want a competitive, fair, and meaningful race.

Power-ups available: Feather, Aero, Draft Boost.

To ensure fair racing, a smart trainer, power meter, and heart rate monitor are required.

No zPower riders and no TT bikes.

Final official results are published on ZwiftPower, divided into A, B, C, and D pace groups using Zwift category enforcement.

Riders with unrealistic performances may be excluded until validation is completed.

For the Dragons Racing Team, this race is also a platform to identify new talent. Strong performances, race intelligence, and commitment will be noticed.

Bring your legs.
Bring your head.
Bring your courage.

Work hard. Race fair. Have fun.

And maybe — just maybe — earn your place among the Dragons.

Let’s achieve greatness together.

description:
This event is built for one thing: unleashing everything you’ve got on a short, explosive climb. It’s your chance to go full gas, push beyond your perceived limits, and battle shoulder to shoulder with fellow racers all the way to the summit.

Victory won’t come from strength alone—it will come from smart racing. Do you conserve energy across the flat approach before launching your attack on the climb? name: Cycling Weekly Club 10
description:
The evening ten is a staple of the British club scene as riders up and down the country will compete with their club mates midweek on a local course. Typically run following the post rush hour traffic the evening ten is as social as it is competitive as road riders, time trailer and club-men come together to compete, chase kudos and bragging rights.
 
About this race
Join staff members of Cycling Weekly, multiple time trial national champion Dr Hutch and a few special guests for a classic, ten mile time trial effort. Using a variety of courses on the Zwift platform the CW club ten will be a test of your power and your pacing. Results will feature on Zwift Power and in Cycling Weekly magazine each week alongside a profile of a competitor.
 
How to ride a TT
As the courses vary, so will your pacing. The flattest courses require a steady sustained effort. With the effort lasting anywhere between 20 and 30 minutes depending on your speed, you will need to know what power you can sustain for that amount of time, getting you across the line with little left in your legs. Finish too fresh and you haven’t pushed hard enough, but if you start slowing before you cross the line, you’ve gone out too hard.
 
When on the hillier courses pacing strategy becomes even more important. Time can be gained on rivals by pushing on the ascents and recovering on the descents, just don’t back off too much. But remember, if there’s a harder climb near the end, you’ll need to hold a little back to maintain your power output in the final push.
 
Your aim should be to ‘get it all out’. If you do this you’ll know you couldn’t have gone any faster. Come back each week and you’ll see an improvement, and be ranked in the series on Zwift Power.
 
How to join the event
Join via the Zwift companion app and be pedalling in a Zwift world well ahead of the event start time. You’ll be given a prompt to join the event in the bottom left of the screen. Do this and you’ll be taken to the start and placed on a conveyor belt where you can keep spinning your legs until you get to the front of the queue. When the time comes your avatar will speed up to 20 miles per hour for a rolling start.
 
About Dr Michael Hutchinson
Ten time winner of the national ten, six time winner of the national 25 and thirteen time winner of the national 50. Dr Hutch is also a best selling author having written about his attempt at the Hour Record and his thirst for going ever faster. He works as an aerodynamic consultant to Team Ireland and writes a weekly column in Cycling Weekly magazine
 
About Cycling Weekly
Established in 1891 Cycling Weekly is the oldest cycling magazine in the world and the only weekly publication. Covering international and domestic racing, the magazine also covers health, fitness and nutrition and reviews of the latest tech.

name: Mountain Massif structured training:  Interval Training
description:
Created by Matteo Cigala, from Cigala Cycling, this structured training session is designed to help you cycle at a higher intensity.  For coaching and all your training needs visit https://coaching.cigalacycling.com/trainsmarterridefaster

About the session:
This session targets aerobic readiness, threshold control, and anaerobic repeatability. The structure blends steady-state work, controlled intensity changes, and high-output Tabata intervals to stress both aerobic and anaerobic systems while maintaining quality through structured recoveries.
Session details:
Warm Up 
10 minutes 40–65% CP 100–110 rpm
Main Set – 2 Rounds
3 minutes 80% CP Free cadence
1 minute 95% CP Free cadence
1 minute recovery 50–60% CP 100–110 rpm

Recovery 
5 minutes 50–60% CP 100–110 rpm


Intervals Sets – 2 Rounds Each round contains 8 repetitions of:
20 seconds 170% CP Free cadence
10 seconds 30% CP Free cadence
5 minutes recovery between rounds 50–60% CP 100–110 rpm
Cool Down 
10 minutes 40–55% CP 100–110 rpm
Total Time: 52 minutes 
Key coaching cues:
Keep the warm up smooth and relaxed to prepare for early intensity changes. Hold steady, controlled power during the 80% and 95% efforts — no surging. Use the short recoveries to reset breathing and cadence before the next block. During the 20-second high-power reps, stay seated, stay stable, and hit clean, repeatable accelerations. Keep the 10-second easy sections truly easy to maintain quality across all eight reps. Use the longer recoveries between rounds to bring heart rate down and restore control.

Safety Note: 
Only undertake vigorous exercise if you are fit and healthy to do so. If you are at all unsure, consult a Physician or Doctor first. All training equipment including Bikes and Turbo trainers should be in full working order. Do not use any piece of equipment that does not come up to the required standard.
More information:

name: Little Tour Ghost Team Stage 2
description:
🇫🇷 Version Française
👻 LITTLE TOUR GHOST TEAM

Format #LTGT – Course aux points

    Préparez vos jambes et votre stratégie ! Le Little Tour Ghost Team adopte un format basé sur l’accumulation de points. Chaque étape compte : les sprints intermédiaires et les KOM seront décisifs, et la régularité fera toute la différence.

Accumulez un maximum de points sur l’ensemble des courses pour viser la victoire finale !
📅 Concept et Horaires

    Quand ? Tous les mercredis à 19h25.

    Durée : 4 courses disputées sur 4 mercredis consécutifs.

    Classement Général : Basé sur les points cumulés (FAL + FTS + FIN).

📊 Barème de Points par Course

    🟢 FAL (First Across Line) :

    Points pour les 40 premiers au passage de la ligne (sprints/arches).

    40, 39, 38… jusqu’au 40e.

    ⚡ FTS (Fastest Through Segment) :

    Points pour les 5 meilleurs temps sur les segments.

    10, 8, 6, 4, 2 points.

    🏁 FIN (Classement Final) :

    Points à l’arrivée de la course.

    100, 95, 92, 90, 89… décroissant jusqu’à 1 point.

⚠️ Condition de Participation

Pour avoir une chance de remporter le titre du Little Tour Ghost Team, la participation aux 4 événements est obligatoire.
🔗 Inscriptions et Infos

    S’inscrire au prochain #LTGT :Lien Zwift

    Consulter le calendrier :Zwifteur.com

🇬🇧 English Version
👻 LITTLE TOUR GHOST TEAM

Format #LTGT – Points-Based Racing

    Prepare your legs and your strategy! The Little Tour Ghost Team adopts a format based on points accumulation. Every stage counts: intermediate sprints and KOMs will be decisive, and consistency will make all the difference.

Rack up as many points as possible across all races to aim for the final victory!

    When? Every Wednesday at 19:25.

    Duration: 4 races held over 4 consecutive Wednesdays.

    General Classification: Based on cumulative points (FAL + FTS + FIN).

📊 Points Scale per Race

    🟢 FAL (First Across Line):

    Points awarded from 1st to 40th place at intermediate arches.

    40, 39, 38… down to the 40th rider.

    ⚡ FTS (Fastest Through Segment):

    Points awarded for the top 5 fastest times on segments.

    10, 8, 6, 4, 2 points.

    🏁 FIN (Final Race Classification):

    Points awarded at the finish line.

    100, 95, 92, 90, 89… decreasing down to 1 point.

To have a chance at winning the Little Tour Ghost Team title, participation in all 4 events is mandatory.

name: Endure IQ Training Squad Session
description:
SESSION FOCUS:
The focus of this session is on building muscular endurance, or your ability
to generate high forces for long periods. This session is designed to involve
repeated periods of high force production in the L3-L4 training zones. These
sessions generate specific strength adaptations for long-distance triathlon.

WARM-UP:
Progressive for 20 min
MAIN SET:
8 min reps at L4 65 rpm (3 min recovery)
6 min reps at L4 65 rpm (2.5 min recovery)
4 min reps at L4 65 rpm (2 min recovery)
3 min reps at L4 65 rpm (1.5 min recovery)
COOLDOWN:
10 min

eventSubgroups.name: Endure IQ Training Squad Session (E)
eventSubgroups.description:
SESSION FOCUS:
The focus of this session is to spend as much time as possible at and above
~90% of your VO2max. The priority is on maintaining high power/pace during the
work intervals. These sessions are highly stressful but great for generating
adaptations that will improve your oxygen-carrying capacity and therefore top-
end aerobic capacity. For long-distance triathletes, these sessions can also
serve as an effective precursor to longer interval sessions.

WARM-UP:
Progressive for 20 min'
PREP:
5 x 30 sec at L5/30 sec at L1
2 min Recovery
MAIN SET:
Sets of 40 sec reps at L5, 20 sec at L1 (5 min recovery between sets)
COOLDOWN:
10 min

name: ZZRC Happy Hour
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Happy Hour 2.4-2.8wkg. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and is one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift.

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2.4 - 2.8 on the ride, with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints, but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised.

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over-paced.

In the event of falling off the back of the main group, you will need to pace well over the group pace to bridge the gap and catch.

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to the group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process.

Our crew is a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift.

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps, and Ride Buddies.

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances, our Sweeps will not be able to help you.

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, with minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to the group.

All our rides have a 30-minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON.

Double Draft is used on this ride

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel
https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX

TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app.

name: ZHCC RUBBERBAND CLUB
description:

Try it - YOU MIGHT JUST LIKE IT!
Our ZHCC Rubber Band Club has the “rubber-band” activated which means that no matter what level you are, you will be able to keep up and the group WILL STAY TOGETHER. The rubber band allows you to ride at your own pace, slow or fast and you are guaranteed to stay in the group.
The ride speed will be slightly less than you would normally experience in a group ride due to the rubber band effect, but we feel that's a small price to pay to allow all level of riders to remain together throughout the ride.
In this supportive environment it’s a great way of completing a full 1 hour ride knowing you wont get dropped or get dragged along by those naughty fliers!
ZHCC do not race each other, we ride as one, have fun and enjoy a group ride.
The ZHCC gang look forward to riding with you.
