name: Team CLS Ride n Explore
description:
Come and join Team CLS for a mid-week ride. Clip in and relax as we ride at a steady C Cat pace with plenty of chat – Don't expect all weeks to be easy, some courses have a lot of climbing but we will support each other and get through them.

This is a chance to enjoy a friendly experienced midweek group ride with regulars who have no Big Egos. This one should definitely be in your weekly schedule as it adds valuable endurance km's at the same time that will improve your fitness.

PACE
After an easy roll out, we will settle into a relaxed pace of 2.5 on the flats and around 3.0 on the climbs, however short ramps may require some increased effort just like IRL. 

It is impossible to find the perfect pace to suit all on a ride like this, and as the leader can't slow repeatedly at the expense of others and a few dropped riders are inevitable, so we apologise in advance. One thing we can assure you we will not chase or talk about flyers.

Team CLS have some awesome leaders, male and female, whose job it is to keep you entertained throughout so they will always be throwing things into the mix on the ride.

You will probably be accompanied by members of our famous ‘ORANGE ARMY’, members of TEAM CLS CC who are dedicated to their vocation of helping others. If you have had a drop out or accidently hit a wrong key, type ‘HELP’ and they will come back and offer you a wheel back to the group.


TEAM CLS LINKS
Check out www.teamclscc.co.uk ...find out about our club, current events and leaders.

name: RollCo: Rolling Tide - 27K
description:
🌊 ROLLING TIDE
Start small. Build big.
Welcome to Rolling Tide — RollCo’s season-long ritual race.

Every week, the distance grows by 1 km.
It begins as a short, explosive opener and steadily evolves into a full-distance endurance epic by year’s end.
This isn’t a one-off event — it’s a shared journey that rises with you.

🏁 Race Format
Rolling Tide is a categorised scratch race.
All riders start together, with categories keeping the racing fair and fast.
The only thing that changes… is the distance.

Week 1 → 1 km
Week 52 → 52 km

Early weeks reward raw power.
Later weeks demand patience, grit, and endurance.
The tide never stops rising.

Rolling Tide is about more than today’s finish line.
It’s about showing up — week after week.
Seeing the same names.
Measuring how far you’ve come as the distance stretches.

You’ll build rivalries.
You’ll track your progress.
You’ll remember the day it all began.

And by the end of the season, everyone who stayed will share the same truth:

“We rode the whole tide together.”

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

Who are Team Ulster Zwifter's (TUZ)?
TUZ was founded by Ross Blayney to enable riders from cycle clubs throughout the province of Ulster (Ireland) to race and train together.
TUZ are simply a group of local Ulster riders & guests with no affiliation to any official organisation, club or body.

Objective:
TUZ's aim is to provide a platform for local cycling clubs mainly but not exclusively from the province of Ulster to train & compete on the Zwift platform.
We make no apologies for targeting local riders and clubs. We feel this adds to the experience and as riders are known to each other (many have raced IRL together or simply known by name or reputation on Strava). This invariably builds in a level of integrity to often inaccurate Zwift power figures.
A dedicated Strava Group has been created where riders can compare local segment times and power figures.
The events are not exclusive to TUZ members and we welcome riders from the international community, just be prepared for a bit of friendly banter if you choose to sandbag one of our events.

name: PTz Workout By EnduranceLab.ie - VO2max Intervals Ride
description:
VO2max Intervals Rides are designed to increase aerobic capacity, or the ability to use oxygen to power your cycling. Aim to complete each 2-minute Interval at an output you could sustain for 6 minutes in race circumstances, which equates to an initial RPE of 7-8 on a 1-10 scale.
Try to maintain a steady output from the start of the first interval to the end of the last interval. Also pay attention to your output in the Zone 1 recovery segments. If you find yourself slowing down in these segments as the workout progresses, you may be doing the Zone 4 intervals too hard.
Feel free to do your Zone 4 efforts uphill, especially if you're training for a hilly event.

description:

name: Rapha Women's 100 Training Ride
description:
She’s your greatest competition. Your loudest cheerleader. The one you want to beat. The one you want to win. Rapha and Zwift are celebrating best rivals and fierce friends. The women who give us a wheel to chase. A line to follow. A reason not to hit snooze. Because friendly competition pulls us forward. The harder you go, the further she’ll get.

Join us as we build up to the biggest women's participation event in cycling, the Rapha Women's 100. Returning 5th-6th September 2026.

name: Stage 5 - Tour Fever
description:
Set your alarms—it’s Tour Fever! Ride the Tour de France and Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift your way, with stages inspired by both races. Cruise it, spin it, or turn up the pace—just don’t miss a stage. 

Two iconic races. One global community. Let’s ride.

name: HISP- The Route of the Week
description:
A race with HISP plus some free XPs? Even better! Every week we will compete on the Route of the Week in Zwift, with three time slots on Wednesdays and three more on Fridays.
You can repeat the race as many times as you want, and we will see who is the fastest each week.
The overall standings of the weekly league will be based on ZRS and will be available on ZwiftPower. https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=3242

¿Una carrera con HISP más unos XPs Gratis? ¡Mejor imposible! Todas las semanas competiremos en la ruta de la semana de Zwift, con tres horarios los miércoles y otros tres horarios los viernes.
Podrás repetir la carrera tantas veces como quieras, y veremos quién es el más rápido cada semana.
La clasificación general de la liga semanal se regirá por ZRS y estará disponible en ZwiftPower. https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=3242

name: 3R True2 Steady Ride [2.0w/kg avg]
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride Event. Your co-operation and teamwork is essential to the success of the ride and we ask that no riders ride off the front of the group. The event is designed as part of 3R’s package of #ProStyleTraining events to assist with the attainment of your training goals and may include intervals over and below the ride average parameters. This is not a race so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the keeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack.  We welcome good banter and aim to create a fun, social atmosphere for your training. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #Ride3R #RideRaceRaise.

#3r

name: TBR MounTRONeering
description:
TBR Mountroneering is your opportunity to climb Watopia’s biggest mountain, Alpe du Zwift, in a regular weekly group ride.

Our awesome team are here to help you reach new heights!

Key points
• Have fun, enjoy the ride and making new friends while suffering a little together
• Roll out at 2.5w/kg for 5km to the base of the climb
• Climb the 12.2km with 1036m of elevation at 2.9w/kg (sub 70 minute ascent)
• An optional Smasho race is often added from turn 4 to the finish line for those with fresh legs
• After the climb the Yellow beacon group will ‘drop like a rock’, your chance to break a PR and potentially hit 100km/hr
• This is a no fence ride, you won’t get heckled for riding at your own pace (whether faster or slower)

name: CMA Ladies Only Social Ride
description:
The focus for this group ride is to have fun! We are not just mums, but women who inspire, encourage, and empower each other. All women are welcome to join, especially those new to Zwift or wanting some good company to start off their week! The pace will be between 1.3-1.7wkg throughout the 45min duration. We hope to see you in Watopia! ABOUT THIS RIDE This ride is lead by Cycling Mums Australia. Our members all share a similar love for two wheels, they are mums, some are non mums, they know a mum, one day want to be a mum and dedicated to make cycling fun and safe for all and our future generations. So if you want to live a rich life with laughter, love and support, join us! http://www.cyclingmumsaustralia.com.au/ 

#cma

name: The Velos Klick - 1km Challenge
description: A klick is a military term for a distance of 1km, and so Team Velos brings you a challenge to complete 1km in the fastest time possible. We will change courses monthly (all Flat courses) and we will have winners from each category at the end of the month. Choose your bike very carefully as it could make all the difference, the challenge is available every night during the week use it as a warm up for a race or just use it to improve your 1km time or power figures, whatever just have fun.

name: Crit Cade Steering Race
description:
Steering Required: This event is designed to maximize the fun of Zwift Steering! If you have a steering device, now's the time to master those apexes and gain an advantage. If you do not have a steering device, unfortunately you will not be able to join.

Get ready for an electrifying dash under the lights in the Crit Cade Steering Racing Experience! This isn't your average crit—it's 8 laps of pure, high-octane racing Downtown Dolphin circuit, but with a thrilling arcade twist!

Power Up Pandemonium: This race features Power Ups! Strategically deploy your Boost Power ups to cut through the field. Timing is everything! Each Boost power up will give you a 10kph speed increase for 2 seconds!

Speed Boosts Galore: Keep your eyes peeled for additional Speed Boosts scattered across the course to give you that extra injection of pace when you need it most. But watch out because these boosts can move around, so you’ll need to be on top of your steering game!

Steering Required: This event is designed to maximize the fun of Zwift Steering! If you have a steering device, it’s the time to master those apexes and gain an advantage.

These events are held within our Zwift Labs club. This feature is still in development and we'd love your feedback on your experience.

name: WTRL Duathlon Opt13 RUN
description: WTRL's Duathlon League offers a unique and thrilling racing experience by combining biking on Zwift with the choice of running on Zwift or outside in real life. This makes it accessible to everyone and the ultimate test of racing versatility!

name: AHDR Bacon Rolls p/b JetBlack
description:
The best way to start (or end) your day! Come and roll with AHDR in a social bunch at around 2.2-2.5w/kg. Please note this is at the higher end of D grade pace so a great way to push yourself a little harder, or ease into the weekend.

Positioning close to our Beacon will bring you the best experience and draft. Fun, teamwork and respect for each other will always be the focus!

All welcome - late join available for first 30 mins. Smiles mandatory, snacks optional.

name: WTRL Duathlon Opt14 BIKE
description: WTRL's Duathlon League offers a unique and thrilling racing experience by combining biking on Zwift with the choice of running on Zwift or outside in real life. This makes it accessible to everyone and the ultimate test of racing versatility!

name: NPRC - Run Every Day Powered By NoblePro
description:
Come and join the fastest growing running club on Zwift.  With a choice of 5 or 10k you can pick your distance. Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it’s not a race unless you want it to be!

Each day is a different route and as new routes are released the courses will change to allow you to bag that badge.

You will run in our in game NPRC jersey and if you complete the event you get to keep it to wear wherever you like.

We also hold special events where you can win an actual jersey to wear in real life.

NPRC Facebook – We have a facebook group where you can join and talk about all things running.  Share your stories and get help and advice.

https://www.facebook.com/groups/1223724692417314/

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/https://kinni.co/devices/ - To see if your treadmill is compatible to link to Zwift.

Join the NoblePro Running Club (NPRC) - https://www.zwift.com/clubs/e7829ccd-bce4-4244-9ccf-4cdc3ef148ff/home

Come and do an easy walk or a quick sprint, whatever suits your training for the day!

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. name: Righto Champ Riot p/b Team VTO
description:
Join Team VTO’s Ben Shepherd (shep_just_shep) and Ben Pratt (the_average_ironman) for a legendary 5km run in partnership with Righto Champ Sunglasses—because every champ deserves to look spec-tacular! 🕶️🏃

This isn’t just any run—it’s a chance to celebrate men’s mental health, share laughs, and break a sweat. Whether you’re fast, slow, or somewhere in between, this event is all about fun and connection. 🎉

🎁 Bonus: A few lucky runners will score stylish Righto Champ Sunglasses!

Lace up, bring your best dad jokes, and let’s run, laugh, and champion mental health together.

name: Workout Wednesday Run
description:
Join the Zwift Runners for a group run workout that will be of benefit to all distance runners.

The speeds for each group are based on a threshold speed of A group 15 kph, B 13 kph, C 11 kph, D 9 kph. We will start the intervals at that speed but increase the speed of the intervals we get into the workout. We encourage runners to choose the group closest to the effort level you want to run at and to keep to the nominal speed for that group to maintain the group dynamic. However if these speeds are significantly too low or high for you then you can choose to run in the group that is closest and then adjust the target speed up to 10% up or down in the game or via the Companion app.

If you have any questions about this event or want to find out more about Zwift Running in general then please visit the Zwift Runners Facebook group or zwift.com/run #gozwiftrun #wow

name: AusCycling Talent Identification
description:
Your journey to the top step starts in your living room.

AusCycling invites you to test yourself against the best. The workout comprises three free ride efforts: 15 seconds, 3 minutes and 12 minutes designed to test your critical power. As with any test or race, ensure you are appropriately warmed up and motivated.

The test is short and sharp, requiring maximum commitment. Erg mode will be turned off during the intervals, you are on your own and its your time to shine.

As you fade through the efforts, use your gears to reduce the resistance and maintain your cadence. Aiming for 90-100rpm for the efforts. Finish the efforts completely spent, the key is to finish all the efforts regardless of how much your power fades or how hard it feels.

Saddle up and enjoy the ride!

 Target Audience;
 16-22yo with no high-performance sport background
 People with vision or physical impairment – any age

People with background in high-performance sport – any age
*If you are outside the ages of 16-22 and have a background in high performance sport or vision/physical impairment please visit https://www.auscycling.org.au/page/virtual-tid and contact us for more information.

name: Chat and roll p/b TBR
description:
Join the TBR crew and roll with Chris Hoiberg for a 45min 2.2 - 2.3 w/kg cruise and chat. Our yellow beacon will average around 40km/h (25mph), consistent with a category C flat ride, with a bit of variation to cater for the majority of riders. Our red beacon may create a second group in the last half of the ride and average around 38km/h (24mph) to help as many riders as possible to finish in a group.

The aim of the ride is to support those wanting to progress from sub 2w/kg rides to something a bit quicker as they improve their strength and fitness. Stronger riders are welcome and your assistance in the group will be appreciated as we will have sweepers working throughout the ride.

So come along at 8.15am AEST each Wednesday and see what makes TBR such a friendly bunch. You're all welcome and you'll have a mighty good time!

We don't use the fence for this ride. All riders should exercise self-control and respect the ride leader by riding with the yellow beacon at all times. Your co-operation helps us provide everyone with a fun, supportive and inclusive ride.

Follow TBR at thebigring.cc to learn more about our events, read ride reports and leave feedback.

name: Masters Racing League
description:
Old Dog Racing presents the Masters Racing League. A series of shorter and relatively easier races for intermediate level riders.

All races are categorized by age, because to be completely frank, it’s the best racing you can find on Zwift. If you know, you know. And if you don’t you will! Everyone is welcome to race with us, bring some friends and nemesis or two.

Come and join the fun; A six week tour, two start times per week, Wednesdays 5:30 pm Eastern and Fridays 5:30 pm Pacific, If you race both events in a week your best finish position will count towards your points total.

Races will be mass start and all riders visible, participants will be issued the Zwift Category kit as an aid to identify which category riders you are currently racing against.

The Categories are divided by age as shown below:
A Under 40 (red) B 40-49 (green) C 50-59 (blue) D 60-69 (yellow) and E 70 and over. (purple)

A word of warning; if you haven’t tried age based (masters) racing before, watch out for the yellow and purple jerseys! Those old guys can be surprisingly fast!

Power ups to help you along your way include: The van, the steamroller, the feather, and aero.

If you find yourself alone, enjoy the scenery and clock up another route badge.

Points awarded to each category in every race are: 25, 20,16,13,11,10,9,8,7,6 and 5 very generous participation points!! (You have to finish!). 

Highest accumulated points in each category wins the series.. you’re going to have to wear an HRM and have a Zwift Power account in order to be awarded points.

Join us on :
Zwift Companion https://www.zwift.com/clubs/0ad7655f-797b-4dc2-940d-b313fca0df0a/home
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/groups/3001328763388965
or Strava -  https://strava.app.link/7JqgUWGwu1b

WOOF!

ZTBR eCycling holds this easy-paced ride every Wednesday! ALL ARE WELCOME!

Audience: The tour is suitable for new riders, those recovering from injury or anyone looking for a fun and regenerative experience.
Pace: This tour focuses on 1.0-2.5 w/kg. Please respect the leader's (who will give directions in the Chat), pace and walk along for better dynamics. Groups at a slower pace than the leader can form,

Stronger riders are welcome to help sweep or act as riding companions for others. If you're having trouble, send a message in Chat to ask for help from the ride scan.

We have late ticket enabled. If you fall off early on, it might be easier to just get off the ride and get back on. Late join works for the first 30 minutes of the trip.

This tour is normally 90 minutes long, but sometimes it can be longer or shorter to cover a specific Zwift route.

Join us on Instagram @ztbr_ecycling [website] ztbr.com.br

#ztbr #z2

name: Bikealicious Wednesday Worlds
description:
Originating with a group a Zwifters located near Boston, Massachusetts, Wednesday Worlds is a banded/stay together ride open to cyclists and triathletes of all abilities, with novice/intermediate/advanced participants especially welcome. As a stay together (Rubberband) ride, you never will get dropped, ( unless you stop pedaling) thanks to Zwift's banded group ride feature. Ride as hard or as easy as you like, without worry of disrupting the overall ride. The goal of this ride is to provide a supportive opportunity for Zwifters to get together to ride and (if desired) socialize. Courses will vary each week and each ride will run 60 or 90 minutes. If you are looking for a consistent weekly ride with all-around enthusiastic people who are interested in all aspects of cycling, this event might be for you!


Your ride leader has a 40+ year history of top level cycling competition on both the road and track. Additionally, he draws on many years of coaching regional and national level cyclists and his work on aerodynamic testing to provide additional support to ride participants. Questions during the ride are encouraged!

name: Major Taylor 1899 (MT1899) Whirlwind Wednesday
description:
Join us for the Major Taylor 1899 Whirlwind Wednesday!

The ride leader will hold ~2.0 w/kg on the flats for the first 50 minutes to keep the group together. In the final 10 minutes, the fence drops, time to PUSH THE PACE and see who can hang on!

This is a non-banded ride, so maintaining the stated pace is key to staying with the beacon. Please respect group ride etiquette.

Why Major Taylor?

Marshall Walter Taylor, known as “Major Taylor”, was a trailblazing cycling legend. In 1899, he became the first U.S. born African American world champion in any sport, wining the 1-mile and 2-mile sprint world titles, along with multiple national championships.

This ride is hosted by the Major Taylor 1899 (MT1899) community cycling clubs across the USA united to honor his legacy. The acronym after each ride leader’s name identifies the hosting club.

Want to ride IRL with a local Major Taylor club?
https://www.majortaylorassociation.org/friends.shtml

Fun FACT: One of Major Taylor’s nicknames was “The Worcester Whirlwind.”

During the months of May through October there may be rides without an assigned ride leader due to the outdoor riding season. We invite all to connect with us on the social media platforms below to stay in the know:

Complete the ride to earn your Major Taylor Whirlwind Kit

name: Workout Wednesday Run
description:
Join the Zwift Runners for a group run workout that will be of benefit to all distance runners.

The speeds for each group are based on a threshold speed of A group 15 kph, B 13 kph, C 11 kph, D 9 kph. We will start the intervals at that speed but increase the speed of the intervals we get into the workout. We encourage runners to choose the group closest to the effort level you want to run at and to keep to the nominal speed for that group to maintain the group dynamic. However if these speeds are significantly too low or high for you then you can choose to run in the group that is closest and then adjust the target speed up to 10% up or down in the game or via the Companion app.

If you have any questions about this event or want to find out more about Zwift Running in general then please visit the Zwift Runners Facebook group or zwift.com/run #gozwiftrun #wow

name: Zwift Crit Racing Club - Lutece Express
description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

name: RollCo: Rolling Tide - 27K
description:
🌊 ROLLING TIDE
Start small. Build big.
Welcome to Rolling Tide — RollCo’s season-long ritual race.

Every week, the distance grows by 1 km.
It begins as a short, explosive opener and steadily evolves into a full-distance endurance epic by year’s end.
This isn’t a one-off event — it’s a shared journey that rises with you.

🏁 Race Format
Rolling Tide is a categorised scratch race.
All riders start together, with categories keeping the racing fair and fast.
The only thing that changes… is the distance.

Week 1 → 1 km
Week 52 → 52 km

Early weeks reward raw power.
Later weeks demand patience, grit, and endurance.
The tide never stops rising.

Rolling Tide is about more than today’s finish line.
It’s about showing up — week after week.
Seeing the same names.
Measuring how far you’ve come as the distance stretches.

You’ll build rivalries.
You’ll track your progress.
You’ll remember the day it all began.

And by the end of the season, everyone who stayed will share the same truth:

“We rode the whole tide together.”

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

description:

Whether you have a connection to multiple sclerosis or are just along for the experience (points) we are excited to have you along for the journey. Whatever the wekly route is, come join a group of passionate cyclists looking to raise funds and awarenes for those living with multiple sclerosis. All Zwift riders are welcome as we ride for a world free of MS. We hope you enjoy the ride and if so, please join Bike MS Zwift Club for year round training and community engagement. Come for the miles of smiles and stay for the XP. 
Bike MS is the largest charity cycling series across the United States consisting of 50 rides and raising over $50 million in 2024 for the National MS Society. Bike MS supports the National MS Society's mission to Cure MS while empowing all people affected by MS to live their best lives. Whether you want to cross the Finish Line in person or take on a new challenge from anywhere — there’s a Bike MS event that’s right for you! 
Check out www.bikeMS.org and experience the ride of your life. Use code Zwift25 for a discount when signing up for a Bike MS in person event.
Come join us for weekly Club Rides: Bike MS ZC
#dontjustride #bikeMS #whateverittakes #strongertogether

name: Crit Cade Steering Race
description:
Steering Required: This event is designed to maximize the fun of Zwift Steering! If you have a steering device, now's the time to master those apexes and gain an advantage. If you do not have a steering device, unfortunately you will not be able to join.

Get ready for an electrifying dash under the lights in the Crit Cade Steering Racing Experience! This isn't your average crit—it's 8 laps of pure, high-octane racing Downtown Dolphin circuit, but with a thrilling arcade twist!

Power Up Pandemonium: This race features Power Ups! Strategically deploy your Boost Power ups to cut through the field. Timing is everything! Each Boost power up will give you a 10kph speed increase for 2 seconds!

Steering Required: This event is designed to maximize the fun of Zwift Steering! If you have a steering device, it’s the time to master those apexes and gain an advantage.

name: Liv du Tour - Hilly - Race
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing have partnered with Liv cycling and The Warrior Games (TWG) with FemmeCycle Collab to bring to you Liv du Tour in celebration of the Le Tour Femmes

9 Stages in 9 days just like the Tour - To keep things simple these are Public races by PACE Group (A-D) with mass release and 4 time options each day.

LIV du Tour is WOMEN only - Racing
GIANT du Tour is MEN only - Racing
Ride du Tour is offered by Bikealicious each day - Banded Group rides 

REGISTER for inclusion in RACING results 

Tours are tracking GC, Polka Dot (climbers) and Green Jersey (sprinters) - ALL segments are in play and ALL are FASTEST through segment - check the rules on how this will work and how we track GC - if you are new to racing it will be a great event to get you going!

For all details and RACING RULES visit our website (link below)
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Discord - LIV-GIANT du Tour channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the event

TWG Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/Eepzzf4xQP
FCC Invite link: https://discord.gg/PucjATepvy

Smart Trainers & HRM - For Racing
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Heart rate monitors are advised

Race Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt or you feel unwell please STOP there will be another day.

name: Mountain Massif structured training:  Interval Training
description:
Created by Matteo Cigala, from Cigala Cycling, this structured training session is designed to help you cycle at a higher intensity.  For coaching and all your training needs visit https://coaching.cigalacycling.com/trainsmarterridefaster

About the session:
This session targets aerobic readiness, threshold control, and anaerobic repeatability. The structure blends steady-state work, controlled intensity changes, and high-output Tabata intervals to stress both aerobic and anaerobic systems while maintaining quality through structured recoveries.
Session details:
Warm Up 
10 minutes 40–65% CP 100–110 rpm
Main Set – 2 Rounds
3 minutes 80% CP Free cadence
1 minute 95% CP Free cadence
1 minute recovery 50–60% CP 100–110 rpm

Recovery 
5 minutes 50–60% CP 100–110 rpm


Intervals Sets – 2 Rounds Each round contains 8 repetitions of:
20 seconds 170% CP Free cadence
10 seconds 30% CP Free cadence
5 minutes recovery between rounds 50–60% CP 100–110 rpm
Cool Down 
10 minutes 40–55% CP 100–110 rpm
Total Time: 52 minutes 
Key coaching cues:
Keep the warm up smooth and relaxed to prepare for early intensity changes. Hold steady, controlled power during the 80% and 95% efforts — no surging. Use the short recoveries to reset breathing and cadence before the next block. During the 20-second high-power reps, stay seated, stay stable, and hit clean, repeatable accelerations. Keep the 10-second easy sections truly easy to maintain quality across all eight reps. Use the longer recoveries between rounds to bring heart rate down and restore control.

Safety Note: 
Only undertake vigorous exercise if you are fit and healthy to do so. If you are at all unsure, consult a Physician or Doctor first. All training equipment including Bikes and Turbo trainers should be in full working order. Do not use any piece of equipment that does not come up to the required standard.
More information:
For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home

name: Hincapie Sportswear Power Hour
description: Sweet Spot Training. This workout focuses on (2) 15 minute "sweet spot" intervals, which are at 88-93% of your current FTP. These intervals train your body to resist fatigue during prolonged periods at a power output just below threshold. Over time, you want to move to longer intervals and more total time in zone. Rest intervals will be 5 minutes or less. Total Time in zone: 30 minutes.

name: VietVelo Weekly Social Ride
description: Come join the riders of VietVelo for our weekly social ride. This ride will alternate weeks between an easier social ride (2-2.5 w/kg) for the 1st, 3rd, and 5th Wednesdays to a harder tempo ride (2.5-3 w/kg) for the other weeks. This is a ride NOT a race. If you feel strong, stay in the front and pull. If you feel weak and are looking for a recovery ride, sit in the middle and chat away. Please add VietVelo to the end of your name so we know you are part of the ride. Visit us at vietvelo.org.

name: Good Time Riders - Pursuit Race
description:
Good Time Riders are a group of Zwifters from across the world who enjoy
riding, training and racing together. We race hard, encourage one another
to be their best, but enjoyment comes first. We have active teams at all
levels racing in Club Ladder, TTT, ZRL and DIRT series. We also run a
regular sub2 group ride for the Zwift community on Mondays, and a club
workout on Fridays. New members are always welcome, you can find us on the
Companion App, Facebook and Discord.

Enjoy the race!

name: Workout Wednesday Run
description:
Join the Zwift Runners for a group run workout that will be of benefit to all distance runners.

The speeds for each group are based on a threshold speed of A group 15 kph, B 13 kph, C 11 kph, D 9 kph. We will start the intervals at that speed but increase the speed of the intervals we get into the workout. We encourage runners to choose the group closest to the effort level you want to run at and to keep to the nominal speed for that group to maintain the group dynamic. However if these speeds are significantly too low or high for you then you can choose to run in the group that is closest and then adjust the target speed up to 10% up or down in the game or via the Companion app.

If you have any questions about this event or want to find out more about Zwift Running in general then please visit the Zwift Runners Facebook group or zwift.com/run #gozwiftrun #wow

name: Mountain Massif Social Training Ride
description:
The Mountain Massif Social Training Ride is all about getting stronger together. This session is a friendly ride where the focus is steady pacing, shared effort, and good company. We ride as one, support each other through the tougher parts of the ride, keep the vibing.

Each session will tackle a route that has challenging elements, but the atmosphere will stay relaxed and social. Stronger riders help keep the group steady, newer riders get a supportive wheel to follow, and everyone leaves with a solid workout in the legs. No racing, no pressure — just a smooth, predictable pace and a community that shows up for each other.

If you want consistent training, a welcoming group, and a session that feels as good socially as it does physically, Mountain Massif is the place to be.

name: Betty Designs Group Workout
description:
A 90-minute workout with build sets of intervals both below + above your FTP. As the intervals get shorter, the effort gets harder!

About the workout designer: Betty Designs' - Kristin Mayer

Kristin is the founder/designer of Betty Designs. She has no formal coaching credentials, but has raced over 100 triathlons and now participates in endurance gravel events. In this workout she shares her favorite long interval workout that she uses in peak training for endurance events. Her goal is to stay ahead of the age curve and gain watts on the bike, even over 50.

name: Rapha Women's 100 Training Ride
description:
She’s your greatest competition. Your loudest cheerleader. The one you want to beat. The one you want to win. Rapha and Zwift are celebrating best rivals and fierce friends. The women who give us a wheel to chase. A line to follow. A reason not to hit snooze. Because friendly competition pulls us forward. The harder you go, the further she’ll get.

Join us as we build up to the biggest women's participation event in cycling, the Rapha Women's 100. Returning 5th-6th September 2026.

name: The Driveway Wednesday Worlds
description:
Let's make crits great again! 

Time to face the facts, sprinting is king when it comes to Zwift racing.  This 4-race multi-lap race rotation is designed to be fast and furious.  Use your power ups to plan a team breakaway.  Deploy a burrito for a solo attack.  Sit in the draft as long as you can before igniting your watt-bomb at the finish line. 

Whatever your tactic, practice it here to become a legendary Zwift racer!

description:
Welcome to The Dirty One—the Nightcrawler ride where we trade smooth tarmac for gravel most of the time and embrace a little controlled chaos. We still roll at our signature sub-1.8 w/kg pace, so everyone stays together. But on Thursdays, the route is all about adventure. Whether you’re chasing endurance, looking for a social ride, or just want something a little different, The Dirty One delivers. No racing, no pressure, no one gets left behind—just a bunch of Nightcrawlers enjoying the ride.

Gravel routes on Zwift are limited, so every now and then we’ll stick to the roads. But one thing never changes: the relaxed pace, the great company, and the fun that keeps everyone coming back. name: Workout Wednesday Run
description:
Join the Zwift Runners for a group run workout that will be of benefit to all distance runners.

The speeds for each group are based on a threshold speed of A group 15 kph, B 13 kph, C 11 kph, D 9 kph. We will start the intervals at that speed but increase the speed of the intervals we get into the workout. We encourage runners to choose the group closest to the effort level you want to run at and to keep to the nominal speed for that group to maintain the group dynamic. However if these speeds are significantly too low or high for you then you can choose to run in the group that is closest and then adjust the target speed up to 10% up or down in the game or via the Companion app.

If you have any questions about this event or want to find out more about Zwift Running in general then please visit the Zwift Runners Facebook group or zwift.com/run #gozwiftrun #wow

name: Power Loop
description:
Power Loop”, designed to enhance muscular endurance, cadence control, and
mental resilience. The session is FTP-based and includes motivational cues,
recovery phases, and a final push, making it ideal for riders looking to build
strength and rhythm indoors. 



A circuit of strength and control designed to push your limits and build resilience.




Perfect for developing muscular endurance, rhythm control, and mental toughness. Every loop prepares you for tougher challenges ahead—inside or on the road.



Interval Breakdown:



1. Warm-Up – 10 minutes



3 min in Z1 @ 90 RPM
3 min in Z2 @ 95 RPM
4 min in Z2 @ 100 RPM


2. Main Set – 4 Repeats of This Block (24 minutes total)



Each loop is a mix of tempo, threshold, and VO2 max work with controlled cadence variation:



2 min in Z3 @ 95 RPM — steady sub-threshold push
1 min in Z4 @ 85 RPM — near threshold, slower cadence
1 min in Z5 @ 75 RPM — VO2 max effort, low cadence strength
2 min in Z3 @ 90 RPM — flush with tempo effort
1 min in Z4 @ 100 RPM — FTP effort with fast legs
2 min in Z2 @ 85 RPM — recovery at sweet spot


3. Active Recovery – 5 minutes

5 min in Z1 @ 90 RPM


4. Final Push – 4 minutes

2 min in Z4 @ 90 RPM
2 min in Z5 @ 100 RPM


5. Cool Down – 5 minutes

5 min in Z1 @ 85 RPM

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 1
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #381

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category 
  
 #wtrl #wtrlttt

description:
Start your day with the serene beauty of Scotland’s iconic misty Loch, all from the comfort of your home. Join us for a peaceful yet invigorating run around the Loch Loop. As the sun rises over the misty waters, feel the calm energy of Scotland’s landscape propel you forward, whether you’re chasing a personal best or simply enjoying the virtual scenery. It’s the perfect way to embrace the early morning and set the tone for a day full of possibilities!

name: Cycle Nation Warsaw Wake Up Call
description:
Welcome to the Cycle Nation Warsaw Wake Up Call. Join us for a scientifically engineered PPP (Propel Progrssive Pace) session. We start with an easy warm-up pace and gradually increase power throughout the ride. In the last 10 minutes we activate three short intervals to really wake up your day! name: INC Relentless Intervals
description:
Suitable for A riders as a base session, or B & C riders wanting to push themselves.

Examples of the drills are – Z2 with 15sec Z5/6 bursts every 6minutes, alternating Z2/Z3 in various durations, Z2 - Z4 ramps of decreasing duration and many other sessions.

All sessions will be around 60-90mins and will include a warm up so just grab your bottles and head straight to the pen.

This is an Innovation Cycling Training Ride Event – all riders are welcome. These events are put together to push you further than before, if you are feeling fresh hop on the front, if you need rest surf the draft. This training ride is part of the INC RELENTLESS training rides that happen daily with each day focusing on a different area of improvement.

Tips: Use the draft to rest and ensure you do not lose the draft.

name: SZR Early Birdies
description:
Welcome to SZR Early Birdies

This is a group ride with the focus on remaining together. The average pace PRIOR to any race finish will be 2.2 wkg. Sprints and intervals will be added at the discretion of the leader and we will at time ride above and below the advertised pace!

Please regroup quickly after sprints, intervals or hills and sit between the yellow and red beacons.
This ride will particularly benefit D and lower C riders looking to get stronger.

name: 3R Octane Interval Ride [~3.2-3.6 w/kg avg]
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride Event. 3R Octane runs five days a week and is designed to provide a solid and fun training platform for riders.

Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 3.2-3.8 W/kg.

The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides, including weekly recovery, or transitional, rides which are usually on a Monday. Short, high intensity intervals, longer sweetspot intervals, flying laps, long and short climbs and exploring little used routes all feature.

The rides are typically around an hour long, but some can be up to two hours long, and all end with a mini race.

The Group welcomes rider interaction through messaging and the Octane discord server and features a super bunch of regulars to which newcomers, and riders stepping up from lower intensity rides, are always welcome. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/

name: GIANT du Tour - Hilly - Race
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing have partnered with GIANT cycling and The Warrior Games (TWG) to bring to you GIANT du Tour in celebration of the Le Tour Femmes

9 Stages in 9 days just like the Tour - To keep things simple these are Public races by PACE Group (A-D) with mass release and 4 time options each day.

GIANT du Tour is MEN only - Racing
LIV du Tour is WOMEN only - Racing
Ride du Tour is offered by Bikealicious each day - Banded Group rides 

REGISTER for inclusion in RACING results

Tours are tracking GC, Polka Dot (climbers) and Green Jersey (sprinters) - ALL segments are in play and ALL are FASTEST through segment - check the rules on how this will work and how we track GC - if you are new to racing it will be a great event to get you going!

For all details and RACING RULES visit our website (link below)
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD groups (links on website)

Discord - LIV-GIANT du Tour channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the event

FRR Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS
TWG Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/Eepzzf4xQP
FCC Invite link: https://discord.gg/PucjATepvy


Smart Trainers & HRM - for RACING
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Heart rate monitors are advised

Race Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt or you feel unwell please STOP there will be another day.

name: 3R VOLT Interval Ride [~2.6-3.2 w/kg avg]
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the keeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. 3R VOLT runs five days a week and is designed to provide a solid and fun training platform for riders.

Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 2.8-3.2 w/kg.

The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides and training needs, the following is a typical week:
Monday – After what has hopefully been a fun backed weekend on the bike, this our recovery session
Tuesday – Tends to be more of a classic interval session, riders usually finish with an average of around 3.0w/kg
Wednesday – We take to the hills and one of our tougher sessions with riders averaging around 3.2w/kg
Thursday – is our no red beacon ride and again tough interval sets and riders finishing around 3.2w/kg
Friday - is a little different, we don't take ourselves too seriously and often play a variety of games and quizzes along side the intervals and riders end up with around 2.8-3.0w/kg

The rides are typically around an hour long, but some may take up to 75mins with the majority finishing with either a ramp or a mini race.

The group welcomes rider interaction through messaging and the VOLT discord server and features a friendly bunch of regulars to which newcomers, and riders stepping up from lower intensity rides, are always welcome. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/

This group ride is not a race so. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #Ride3R #RideRaceRaise.

name: 3R SPARK Interval Ride [~2.2-2.5 w/kg avg]
description: This is a 3R Group Ride Event (not a race). 3R Spark runs five days a week and is designed to be an accessible and sociable training session, aimed primarily at riders is Cat-D. Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 2.0-2.5 W/kg. The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides. For interval sessions we aim to average between 2.2-2.5 for the session, but there will be times above and below. Thursday and Friday sessions often include an optional mini-race at the end. Rides are typically around an hour long. Spark is a great introduction to group rides on Zwift, we are a friendly and supportive group who love to see one another succeed. We always have a sweeper (red beacon) whose wheel you can grab if you get dropped. There’s always plenty of good chat, via in-ride messages or on Discord. Come and join us! name: Endure IQ Training Squad Session
description:
The focus of this session is on building your tolerance to intensities similar
to those during a 70.3 triathlon. You will be working in the L3b training
zone. You should hope to see reduced HR drift within this zone as you complete
more of these sessions. From a physiological perspective, these sessions help
promote fat oxidation, and structural changes at a muscular level, such as
increased mitochondrial content and capillarization.

WARM-UP:
20 min
PREP:
5 x 30'' L4 /30' L1
2 min recovery
MAIN SET:
20 min working around 70.3 pace (2 min up and 2 min under)
5' between sets
COOLDOWN:
10 min

name: MAAP In The Field: UK Group Ride
description:
MAAP In The Field: UK Group Ride

Join the MAAP crew each week, we’ll roll as a group at a moderate 2-2.5 w/kg pace. The course varies each week, with a range of undulating routes. Join our global community for a social ride and unlock the exclusive MAAP kit. Jump on the chat, ask us any questions you might have and remember that this isn’t a race, save that for Wednesdays!


How do I unlock the Off The MAAP Kit?


Not only will you be repping the kit in-event, but finish any of our weekly rides to unlock the Off The MAAP Kit in your garage, so you can proudly wear the M-Flag design on any ride.

About MAAP:

MAAP exists for the progression of cycling. An independent brand, we’re committed to bringing a new perspective on performance cycling apparel. Every piece that we design evokes our obsession with quality, function, and precision. Fabrics are hand-selected from premier Swiss and Italian mills and are constructed at the most respected factories across Europe. Using the feedback and support from racing teams and cyclists around the globe, our industry-leading product developers are relentlessly refining and evolving every product, season after season. Visit: maap.cc

Stay up to date with the latest MAAP In The Field rides, product launches, cycling events and see who’s topping the leaderboards each week. Connect with the global MAAP community by joining our MAAP Strava Club: https://www.strava.com/clubs/293623 for a global epic from our In the Field series, stay posted on our Facebook page: http://facebook.com/maap.cc or fill your feed via: https://www.instagram.com/maap.cc/.

name: SZR Sunrise Ride
description:
Welcome to SZR Sunrise

C and D  Ride
Tempo ride with optional sprint sections. Non sprinters will work as a group to create as much draft as we can for the sprinters.
Sprints will be added at the discretion of the leader.
We will at times ride above and below the advertised pace, please don’t feel the need to tell the leader they will be aware but the ride average will be as advertised.
This is NOT a recovery ride, we work hard and work as a team.

E Ride
The focus is on the Group and keeping together while having fun to make the time fly fast!
The ride tempo is shown next to the ride category, this is rider weight / gender dependant.
Note that the average is for the ride prior to any optional faster finish (with a beacon).
The ride leader will aim (prior to any faster finish) to ride mid parameters after a short warmup period.
There might be slight variations above or below the average during the ride.


NB:
Please always respect the ride leader and follow his / her instructions.
The ride tempo is shown next to the ride category, this is rider weight / gender dependant.

name: Kiwi Crew Ride
description:
Established in 2018 by former NZ Tour Pro Greg Henderson this Kiwi group ride is now a classic! Our community continues to grow with some of NZ's best E-Sports racers taking to the line each week.

The ride starts off at a moderate 2.5 w/kg average where there’s time for a bit of banter or to spin a good yarn so stay close as you don't want to miss out on the fun! But rachet up the shoes because at the 30 minute mark things get spicy with the Riot After Party! Race to the finish and see how long you can hang on or if you can take on some of the best!

Will you be this weeks Riot winner?

Please respect the ride and stay with the ride leader (yellow beacon) until the Riot hits with around 15 mins remaining, at that point you can race the riot to the finish, or cruise to the finish. Everyone is welcome to join.

* Everyone with a Power Meter and / or Smart Trainer is welcome to join.
* Use of the Coffee Stop during the Riot will incur a 1 min time penalty.
* New cadence rules in play.
* Winners subject to verification requests.

name: Team Italy Spicy Coffee Italian Ride
description:
Se cerchi la giusta compagnia per prepararti al fine settimana sei nel posto giusto.
Lo scopo della SPICY COFFEE ITALIAN RIDE è quello di stare tutti insieme, sfruttare la scia del gruppo e fare due chiacchiere ad un ritmo medio fra i 2.0 e i 2.5 w/kg per 90 minuti, il late join è attivo per 30 minuti.
Questa NON è una gara.
Segui le istruzioni dei leader(giallo) per un gruppo compatto.
Ricordati di non superare la fence (barra rossa) altrimenti verrai eliminato.
Partecipa a questa ride per sbloccare la divisa del team italy.
BUONA PEDALATA A TUTTI
TEAM ITALY organizza una vasta gamma di eventi, tutti con le seguenti regole:
-in una pedalata di categoria D, alcuni ciclisti sono principianti, segui le istruzioni del
leader (logo giallo) che appaiono come testo al centro e tieni presente che il ritmo sarà fra i 2.0 e i 2.5 w/kg
-Il valore w/kg sarà diverso per tutti voi, il motivo principale sarà il peso, seguito dalla
capacità di utilizzare la scia e l'equipaggiamento della vostra bici in gioco
-abilitare i messaggi nelle opzioni zwift, fondamentali per una buona esperienza
-le pedalate della categoria D sono facili per un ciclista con C alto, 3w/kg ftp, impegnative per un C basso, 2.5 w/kg ftp, estreme per un ciclista D con 2 w/kg FTP, lo stesso per le
corse C, facili per un A, 4w/kg ftp, impegnative per B 3.2 w/kg ftp, ed estreme per C con 2.5
w/kg ftp.

Spicy Coffee Italian Ride's goal is to stay together, enjoy the group draft, and have a bit of easy chat at an average pace between 2.0 and 2.5 w/kg for 90 minutes, late join is enabled for 30 minutes.
This is NOT A RACE.


Follow the leaders' instructions (yellow beacons) to keep the group tight.
Remember the Fence is KILLER, 60 seconds over and you'll be out of the event.
Join this ride to unlock the Team Italy Jersey.

- in a D category ride, some riders are beginners, and follow the leader's instructions (yellow
beacon) that appear as text in the middle and keep in mind that the pace will be between 2.0 and 2.5 w/kg


-The w/kg value will be different for all of you, the main reason will be weight, followed by the
capacity to use the draft and your in-game bike equipment
- enable the messages in Zwift options, fundamental for a great experience

FTP, is extreme for a D rider with 2 w/kg FTP, same for C rides, easy for an A, 4 w/kg ftp,
challenging for B's, 3.2 w/kg ftp, and extreme for C's 2.5 w/kg ftp.

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 6
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #381

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category 
  
 #wtrl #wtrlttt

name: Run 10K Every Day Powered By NoblePro
description:

The event has a healthy group of leaders who are friendly and chatty and will help you achieve your goal, not matter your experience. Feel free to join in the chat and become addicted like we all are.

Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it's not a race.

name: 6Points Challenges Group Thursday Training Ride
description:
This is a TRAINING event, category D, with a yellow beacon leader. The beacon leader will ride up to a 2.5w/kg pace average wherever possible. The beacon may employ the fence at times.

Please look out for this training ride on Thursdays, every week, at 9.55am UTC in the UK, 4.55am EDT in the US, and at 10.55 CET in Europe. Use #6Points to search for our rides on the Zwift website.

This weekly 6Points Mallorca Thursday training ride is intended to provide a challenge for riders, and is open to all timezones. You should ride as a group, following the instructions of the beacon ride leader(s) for any sprints, intervals and spicy segments, regrouping after each when requested. All our group rides also have a closing minirace, to start from behind the beacon. The fence may be used to control starts for these spicy sections.
About the in-real-life Reverence 6Points Mallorca
The ultra-distance Reverence 6Points Mallorca real life cycling event, with Title sponsor Reverence Hotels, is ridden around Mallorca and raises money for charity, currently supporting Asdica, who work on behalf of disabled children, and Save-the-Med. Now in its third edition, it has already earned a reputation as a fun but tough event that epitomises cycling at its best. 6Points has raised over €100,000 for charities in this way over three years.

6Points Mallorca is a ride around the whole of the beautiful island of Mallorca, covering well over 420 kms, climbing 7500 metres and touching the four compass extremities, as well as the highest and lowest points of Mallorca, over 3 days. See https://6pointschallenges.com/ for more about our in-real-life events. We also run these events in Ibiza / Formentera and Menorca.

Like our Zwift group ride, 6Points Mallorca is NOT a race. It is an opportunity to participate in a challenging ride, with like-minded cyclists, to enjoy Mallorca’s diverse beauty and the friendship and camaraderie of fellow riders. 6Points supports sustainable cycling, whose riders care for the environment and practise courtesy to fellow road users.

We have organized our 6Points Zwift training ride series to suit what we believe is relevant to bike riders’ interests in performance and improvement, bearing in mind the in-real-life 6Points Mallorca challenge which is also ridden in groups with controlled pace.
The 6Points Zwift group ride
As we expect our riders to be able to ride up to 100 miles at or around a 15mph average on our irl (in-real-life) rides, such steady riding members should be comfortable with Zwift Category D. Beacon leaders communicate via Zwift message (always) and/or Discord (sometimes) to vary the pace to allow for sprints, intervals and optionally a mini-race towards the end of the rides, with regrouping after each sprint. Make as much use of drafting as you can, for more effective sprinting and rest intervals.

During the ride, the beacon will announce any sprints, and the ride will finish with a minirace to the end of the ride of between 3kms and 8kms depending on the course. The Beacon will announce this too.

Results (the finishing order, relevant to the minirace which we will all start together) can be seen at the end of the ride on screen, and we will, in common with many other ride series, publish your results on zwiftpower.com too, based on the ride category D.

All bikes and Power-Ups (PU) are allowed, but it is better not to use TT bikes to ensure drafting. Please add 6Points (X) to your Zwift name to allow your ride presence to be recognized, where X is your own ride category. Categories in Zwift are related to your Functional Threshold Power (FTP); use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg to get the W/kg that applies to you.

On this ride series, all riders and categories are welcome, but bear in mind that rides are designed for:

Category D: 2 W/kg to 2.5 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 2.5w/kg pace average or below.

PLEASE NOTE: Strava data for our rides must be open (not private or hidden). Please use a heart rate monitor so that we can monitor correlated power and heart rate to help assure fair riding.

You can use our Discord channel to talk to each other at https://discord.gg/bPsQCNh

Please see the 6Points Zwift page link at https://6pointschallenges.com for more, including how we support our chosen charities.

https://6pointschallenges.com/

#6points

name: DIRT 505 Thursday Endurance Ride
description:
Welcome to the DIRT 505 Thursday Endurance Ride!

Please join us weekly on Thursdays at a pace of 2.6-2.8w/kg for 90 minutes.

The 505 rides take place Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday for 90 minutes at the same time and same consistent pace. Saturday's we ride for 120 minutes.

We kick off our rides with a 5 minute pace at 2.2w/kg to get us warmed up and together as a team. The fence is used throughout the ride to keep everyone together. The fence will not kick you off the ride but we do encourage all our riders to stay together as close to the beacon as possible. Our rides offer a 30 minute late join option.
The ride leader will stay as close to ride pace as possible. We try to change up the routes each week and some of the routes may include some small to moderate climbs.

Our group exists to encourage and build up cyclists around the world no matter your time zone, fitness level, pro or amateur. We exist to encourage and build up a team culture of unity in the cycling community.

name: The Chop by AHDR
description:
AHDR THE CHOP

Being "in the chop" is an Aussie expression that you won't read about in the UCI rulebook. It's one of the many nuances of bike racing that only comes with experience.

Sometimes when you're in a race and find yourself in the final break-away bunch you might get asked "are we in the chop?" or "are we chopping it?". This is referring to collusion between the lead riders to work together until the finish. Many times a break-away will be doomed in the final kilometres because everyone starts playing cat and mouse, attacking, sitting up, etc.

But all that goes out the window in the last lap. This is generally where the group comes together and the final push begins. Working together goes out the window and is every man or woman for themselves for the final sprint to the line.

AHDR The Chop is a flat fast time-based handicap race. Do you always get blown out the back on the start of a multi grade race trying to hang onto the guy going with A grade pushing 5w/kg. Well not on The Chop. Released in Grades there are time splits from D to A with the intention of all coming together at the end for the big finish. Each Grade wears a different AHDR/Zwift kit making each grade easily identifiable on who's wheel you want to catch if they go past.

Races happen on Thursday evenings. We plan to add further races in the future. No single race has been the same. Many variables are at play on The Chop including course (which is generally a flat course), race numbers, and the inevitable sandbaggers. It has been called a team time trail and cat and mouse but the real racers know it only as "THE CHOP". Do you have what it takes to take the glory?

A Grade – AHDR GIANT Kit
B Grade – HDR Kit
C Grade – Fluoro Pink
D Grade – Fluoro Camo

description:

name: 5K Down Under
description:
Join us for a 5k group run led by Australian age-group triathlete Ben Shepherd. Ben is an avid triathlete and Zwifter who - like many of us - balances his training with work and family. He's a thirty-something father of a young daughter and credits triathlon with helping him lose over 50lb (25kg). He's a Ironman World Championships finisher (2016) and has qualified to represent his native Australia at the ITU Age-Group World Championships in September of this year.

After suffering a tendon injury to his patella (kneecap), he's working back to fitness with 100% treadmill running and is happy to have some company! Join him for a relaxed pace 5K. Come just to run or to chat about triathlon, Zwift, or where to get the best flat whites. Ben will be leading at 5:30/km (8:50/mi) pace, but feel free to join in at your own pace. This is a social run, not a race, so leave the racing flats at home for now.

name: Slowtwitch Indoors: Rise & Grind
description:
ABOUT THIS RIDE

Rise & Grind is an early morning bracer for the East Coast crowd. Be sure to get a warm-up in and look to enter the staging zone approximately 5 minutes before go-time. All levels are welcome and supported -- and don't worry! So long as you keep the pedals turning, you won't be dropped -- especially handy for those that have found that their coffee hasn't quite kicked in yet.

#slowtwitchindoors

name: Film My Run 500 with NoblePro
description:
Join Stephen Cousins and NoblePro for a 500 metre climb. Set your treadmill to 12% incline and run 4.2km of distance to reach 500 metres elevation. If your treadmill doesn't go that high, set it as high as it will go and join us anyway!

The run will be progressive starting at a walking pace of 5kph rising to 7kph for the final kilometre. Get on to the balls of your toes and get your calf muscles to do the work. This continuous uphill effort will help build strength and endurance for those hilly trail runs

This event is sponsored by the ever popular Noble Pro treadmills. You can get a discount on a NoblePro SMART treadmill from this link https://zwift.run/noble-pro

You can watch the run on the live stream at http://youtube.com/ZwiftRunChannel

Join the FMR Run Club for more fun events at https://www.zwift.com/uk/clubs/6afca04c-8fac-4ffa-b700-f27a73d7f3dd/join

description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

name: GRIT Tempo-ish Thursday
description:
This is a group ride that has competitive sprint segments. Although not mandatory, riders are encouraged to participate in sprints. After each sprint we quickly regroup and continue the tempo paced lap. The motto of the ride has always been "Faster and farther together". Come have fun with us as we train to improve sprinting capability.

We ride a course that is approx. 5 km (3 miles) and we continue laps for 60 minutes. Each lap has a timed sprint zone and we sprint at this area on each lap for about 7 sprints in the 60 minute ride.

The tempo pace is around 3.0 w/kg and we normally have a large peloton of 30+ riders moving at this pace.

Sprints are short duration (10 - 30 seconds) and will be competitive as riders use maximum power to compete for the fastest sprint time.

name: Phoenix Rising As One
description:
Please join us on Phoenix Rising As One and, at least for a little while, overcome some of those annoying real life stresses. Phoenix Rising As One is a joyful social group ride. We welcome riders of all types and strengths to join us for an hour of fun and camaraderie. 

The yellow beacon will attempt to ride at a pace of between 1.5 and 1.8 w/kg.  There will be no fence and we welcome riders to ride at whatever pace they want – the objective of the ride is to be together which we are via text and discord.  And we will have a fab group of sweepers to accompany and inspire riders who wish to ride at a gentler pace.  We intend that no one ride alone unless they want to.

We will ride a variety of routes, attempting to cover some of the less traveled routes in Zwift and earning the occasional badge.  We will ride flattish routes although some nasty shorter climbs or non paved surfaces will inevitably be included. 

So wherever you are located, please join us for a rollicking fun hour of cycling.

For more information on all our weekly events, join our club Phoenix Rising on Zwift Companion.

Join us on Discord during the ride: https://discord.gg/mNMva8ekJR
Check us out on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/groups/615972979730125/

name: One El' of a Ride
description:
Join Team ZF every Thursday for a fun, friendly, and sociable hour of riding! Led by our trusty Yellow Beacon, El, we’ll explore the varied worlds of Zwift together.

* Pace: 1.8 – 2.2 w/kg
* Vibe: Social and chatty (Not a race!)
* Format: Keep the pack tight around the Yellow Beacon, though optional sprints will be called out along the route.
* Support: Expert sweep team on duty.

Our goal is to start and finish as one happy group. Come for the fitness, stay for the banter.

Ride On!

#teamzf

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 10
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #381

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category 
  
 #wtrl #wtrlttt

name: ZLDR Easy Breezy 8kph Run
description:
ZLDR Easy Breezy 8kph Run


Calling all Runners and Walkers - We want you! 


Round out your week with our Easy Breezy 8kph run. Whether you are shaking off of hard workout or just looking for a chill jog, our Thursday run is all about enjoying the journey at a relaxed pace. Join us as we chat, laugh, and embrace the pace. No rush, just vibes!


Join Zwift Long-Distance Runners (ZLDR) run club for a relaxed 6.4 km run. Whether you want to use this time to walk just to get your blood flowing or push for a new personal best or anything in between, this is a great session to join! Even if you can't join for the full distance, come for whatever you have available. We are a flexible group of walkers/runners who want to help you get consistent and get results.


ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your running dreams and help you develop your running skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners and walkers who want to help you set and achieve new goals!
